tei:titleStmt.tei:title: ༄༅/ /gnyis pa de nyid nyams su len pa la/smin par byed pa dbang bskur ba'i tshul dang*/grol bar byed pa lam bsgom pa'o/ /dang po la dbang ji ltar bskur
༄༅/ /gnyis pa de nyid nyams su len pa la/smin par byed pa dbang bskur ba'i tshul dang*/grol bar byed pa lam bsgom pa'o/ /dang po la dbang ji ltar bskur

tei:div.tei:p: "$ ༄༅// gnyis pa de nyid nyams su len pa la/ smin par byed pa dbang bskur ba'i tshul dang*/ grol bar byed pa lam bsgom pa'o// dang po la dbang ji ltar bskur ba dang*/ dbang 'di nyid kyi rgyu rkyen bshad pa'o// dang po ni/ rgyud pa'i chos 'di nyid dang 'brel ba'i dbang bskur ni/ pha rgyud gsang ba 'dus pa/ ma rgyud 'khor lo bde mchog /gnyis med dus kyi 'khor lo thams cad ro mnyam pa'i dpa' bo dang mkha' 'gro thams cad gcig tu bsdoms pa'i bcom ldan 'das thugs rje chen po bde mchog dus kyi 'khor lo rdo rje phag mo dang snyoms par 'jug pa'i rang byung yi ge lnga'i dkyil 'khor chen po'i (3)bdag nyid sku bzhi ngo sprod dbang bskur mkha' 'gro yid bzhin nor bu'i khrid gzhung ltar bkod par 'dod la/ de'i rim pa'ang*/ rin po che karma pakshi'i phyag bzhes bzhin brjod na/ 'di'i bla ma brgyud pa'i rim pa khyad par ba zhig ni/ bcom ldan 'das rdo rje 'chang*/ rdo rje rnal 'byor ma/ gsang ba'i bdag po/ klu sgrub/ 'phags pa lha/ birwa ba/ ind+ra bhū ti/ padma 'byung gnas/ lū yi pa/ la ba pa/ dril bu pa/ tai lo pa nas rim bzhin brgyud pa yin zhes 'byung la/ de lta'i dbang bskur ba'i tshul la/ yo byad tshogs par bya ba dang*/ dngos gzhi dbang bskur ba'i rim pa'o// dang po ni/ dben zhing yid du 'ong ba bar chad dang bral ba'i gnas su phyag rgya lnga/ cang te'u/ rdo rje dril bu/ rkang gling*/ rol mo/ gtor ma/ tshogs kyi yo byad/ phyag rgya ma (4)lo so gnyis ma/ bcu drug ma/ bcu gnyis ma/ brgyad ma ste bzhi ngo tsha ba dang 'jigs skrag dang bral ba'i dad mos phul du byung ba rnams tshogs par byas nas srod dam nam phyed kyi dus bla ma la gsol ba gdab par bya'o// gnyis pa la bum pa/ gsang ba/ shes rab ye shes/ bzhi pa dbang bskur ba'i tshul lo// dang po ni/ thugs rje chen po rgyal ba rgya mtsho bde ba chen po dus kyi 'khor lo yab bka' yum bkas rgyud yongs su smin par byas la/

de ltar byed pa'i cho ga'ang da lta karma bka' brgyud la grags pa'i rgyal ba rgya mtsho dang rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i bka' 'di dag gi rim pa yin la/ dbang po ches rno ba'i gang zag theg pa gsum gyi dge rtsa'i stobs thob pa'i rigs sad kyi skal can la ni/ tshul 'di nyid kyi dbang bskur bas kyang grub ste/ de'ang rdo rje slob ma dang slob dpon thams cad thugs rje chen po yab yum dbyer mi phyed pa'i shrī he ru ka nyid kyis lhas lha la dbang gi ched du gsol ba 'di ltar du gdab par bya ste/ sangs rgyas kun gyi sku gsung thugs// bla ma'i rdor gsum gcig gyur la// lus ngag yid gsum gus phyag 'tshal// dpag med mkha' 'gro (5)rgya mtsho yi// sku gsung thugs mchog bdag la stsol// zhes gsol ba gdab/ phyag rgya ma bzhi la rdo rje'i rigs sogs bzhi'i kha dog can gyi smos ma thag pa'i phyag rgya lnga'i rgyan gyis brgyan nas cang te'u rdor dril sogs rol mo thogs te gcer bur phyung zhing dar gyi ga sha bgos te/ de'ang dang por rtsa sum cu so gnyis kyi khams 'bab pa'i nus ldan rig ma lo so gnyis ma slob dpon la phul nas/ sangs rgyas 'dus sku rdo rje 'dzin// 'khor ba'i 'dam nas 'dren mdzad pa// he ru ka dpal dgongs su gsol// mtshan ldan rigs bzhi'i ḍā ki ma// dgyes pa'i phyir du mchod par 'bul// rdo rje padma mnyam sbyor ba// de yi dngos grub bdag la stsol// zhes gsum gyis gsol ba gdab/ slob dpon gyis kyang slob ma'i ched du phyogs bcu'i he ru ka pa yab yum la gsol ba 'di ltar du gdab par bya ste/ phyogs bcu'i he ru ka pa thams cad bdag la dgongs su gsol/ khyed cag sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyis bdag gi slob ma'i lus ngag yid gsum smin grol du mdzod cig /byin gyis rlobs shig /ces gsol (6)ba gdab bo// de nas slob mas shes rab ma lo so gnyis ma la phyag dang maṇḍal phul nas/

lha mo bdag la dgongs su gsol// 'khor ba'i 'dam las bskyab pa'i phyir// sku gsung thugs kyi dkyil 'khor du// bdag zhugs lha ngo bstan par mdzod// ces gsol ba gdab pas/ lha mo des/ bskal pa sngon nas da lta'i bar// khyod ni bsod nams skal bar ldan// gsang ba chen po'i dkyil 'khor du// lha mos khyod ni gzhug par bya// zhes gnang bar bsams la/ lha mo des slob ma la bde ba chen po'i snying rjes rjes su chags pa'i 'od zer gyis/ bdag gi spyi bor chos 'byung dkar po'i dbus su rang byung gi yi ge a e waṃ ma ya la/ rdo rje rnal 'byor ma dkar mo dang*/ rigs bzhi'i ḍā ki dkar mo bzhi ste lngas bskor ba'i lha mo re re zhing gi thugs kar yang a e waṃ ma ya ste/ rang byung gi yi ge lnga dang ldan par gsal zhing*/ yi ge re re'i mthar yang hri ha ri ni sas bskor ba gsal bar snang ba mdzad pa bstan te/ 'di lta bu'i dkyil 'khor du zhugs shig pa'i bkas/ zhugs nas lha mo gang gi dngos grub sbyin par 'gyur ba (7)brtag pa'i ched du/ me tog 'dor ba na tshig bcad 'di ltas 'od zer du gzhug ste/ gsang ba chen po'i pho brang du// rig pa'i me tog 'di dor bas// las dang skal bar 'brel ba yi// lha mo gang la 'bab par shog /ces dor bas/ lha mo des gang la phog pa'i rigs de'i lha mo lhag pa'i lhar ngo sprad nas/ slar slob mas/ lha mo la gsol ba gdab par bya ste/ 'di skad du/ bdag ni nyon mongs 'dam nang du// bying ba 'dren mdzad rnal 'byor mas// bum dbang bdag la bskur du gsol// smin grol byin rlabs stsal du gsol// zhes dang*/ slar lha mo la bos nas/ rang byung rang shar bdag med ma// khyod ni ma ste bdag ni bu// dpag med mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho yis// bdud rtsis bdag ni bskyang du gsol// zhes gsol ba btab/ de nas lha mos dam tshig bsgrag par bya ba ni/ dam tshig bsrungs pa'i bsod nams kyis// da lta nyid du 'grub par byed// bud med mthong ba thams cad la// g.yon nas lan gsum bskor ba gyis// gus pas yid kyis phyag byos la// (8)lan gsum bar du gsol btab na// bdag gis mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho yi// dngos grub da lta nyid du sbyin// zhes brjod/

de nas bla mas slob ma'i mgo bo'i tshangs bug tu shes rab kyi nu ma 'tshir ba'i 'o ma dbab nas/ bde stong dbyer med kyi ye shes skyes pa na/ dbang gi don mngon sum du byas pa ji lta ba de ltar ngo sprad de/ de ltar slob dpon gyis mdzad kyang bde stong gi dbang don gyi ye shes ma skyes na/ slob mas slar yang lha mo la 'khyud pa dang 'o byed pa dang nu ma 'tshir ba sogs byas pas bde gsal mi rtog pa'i bdag nyid kyi ye shes skye bar 'gyur ba yin pas/ de nyid bum pa'i dbang bskur ba'i stobs kyis thob pa'i bum pa'i dbang dngos yin par shes su gzhug ste/ slar slob mas/ bdag ni bud med thams cad la// mchog tu dad pas zhabs spyir len// gus pa chen po'i bka' drin dran// mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho'i ngo bor ni// 'bral ba med pa'i mchod pa bgyi// zung 'jug 'gyur med byin gyis rlobs// zhes dam tshig khas blangs nas/ slob dpon gyi de ltar bum pa'i dbang gis mos spyod kyi sa nas sa bcu pa chos kyi sprin man (9)gyi sa chen po rnams thob pa la dbang bas phyi don rang bden pa'i zhing khams dang dkyil 'khor dang mchod rdzas sogs rang bzhin bden grub par med pas chos thams cad phyi don du rtogs pas brtags pa'i rten 'byung tsam gyi dkyil 'khor pa nyid du don gyi dbang thob pa yin pas da phyin chad bkod pa'i rdzas dang bris pa ri mo'i rdul tshon dang dkyil 'khor la sogs par yang dbang len 'dod mi bya zhing gal te byas na shes bya thun mong ba'i rtsa ltung dgu pa dang bcu gcig pa sogs kyis reg par 'gyur ro// gnyis pa gsang ba'i dbang ni/ khams dkar cha zla ba'i cha shas bcu drug bzhu nus pa'i rig ma lo bcu drug ma phyag rgya lnga sogs sngar bshad pa'i rgyan gyis brgyan te/ tshogs kyi 'khor lo dang lhan cig slob dpon la phul te/ slob dpon yab yum la gsol ba gdab pa ni/

dpa' bo mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho yi// gtso bo yab yum bdag la dgongs// ye shes lnga yis rab brgyan pa'i// gsang dbang bka' drin stsal du gsol// zhes gsol ba btab nas/ bla mas phyogs bcu'i rdo rje 'chang ba thams cad la phyag byas te/ phyogs bcu'i rdo rje 'chang ba gdan gsum gyi lha tshogs rnams kyis bdag gi slob ma 'di dag gi lus ngag yid (10)gsum byin gyis rlobs la bde bas gang bar mdzad du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab/ slob ma cung zad ya nga na// gdong dar la sogs pas bcings nas// bla ma yab yum snyoms par zhugs pas bde ba chen po 'od gsal ba'i 'od zer gyis/ yab yum nyid kyi mgrin pa'i rtsa 'dab bcu drug gi dbus su rang byung gi yi ge lnga dang rtsa 'dab bcu drug la ḍā ki ma dmar mo bcu drug gis bskor ba gsal bar snang bar mdzad de/ slob ma la bstan te/ slob dpon yab yum gyis 'di lta bu'i dkyil 'khor du zhugs shig pa'i bkas me tog 'dor du gzhug ste/ yi ge 'gyur med pho brang du// bdud 'joms me tog 'di dor bas// las dang skal bar 'brel ba yi// lha mo gang la 'bab par shog /ces dor te gang la phog pa de lhag pa'i lhar ngo sprad nas/ slar yang slob dpon yab yum bde bas tshims pa'i sku gsung thugs kyi 'od zer gyis phyogs bcu'i zhing rab 'byams kyi gdan gsum tshang ba'i rdo rje 'chang ba rnams spyan drangs nas/ slar yab yum gyi mgrin par son pa na e dmar po dang waṃ yig dkar por gyur/ de nyid las byang chub sems kyi bde ba'i rten khams dkar dmar gnyis rgya mtsho chen po (11)'brub pa bzhin du 'brub ste/ rtsa dbu ma'i rgyud du bab pas/ snying kha lte ba gsang ba rnams su rim bzhin brgyud de/ dga' ba mchog dga' khyad dga' lhan cig skyes dga'i ye shes nyams su myong bzhin pas byang sems rdor pad du phab nas/ slob mas lces blangs nas byang chub kyi sems de'i 'od zer gyis slob ma'i mgrin pa'i rang byung gi yi ge lnga ḍā ki bcu drug dang bcas pa gsal bar gyur pas bla ma yab yum gyi byang sems des slob ma'i mgrin pa'i yi ge ḍā ki dang bcas pa la zhugs pas chang la phabs btab pa lta bu'i nus pa rnyed nas yi ge ḍā ki sogs kyi sgo gsum bde ba chen pos tshim nas/

de ltar tshim pa'i bde dgas slob ma'i lus sems thams cad kyi lha tshogs bde gsal mi rtog pa'i ye shes kyis rgyud myos nas sgrib pa'i tshogs thams cad gsal nas rdo rje slob dpon yab yum dang*/ slob ma'i bha ga'i dkyil 'khor bltas mthong gi cho gas gsang ba'i dbang bskur ba'i stobs kyis thob pa'i gsang dbang dngos yin par ngo shes su gzhug nas/ slob mas/ bdag ni rdo rje 'chang chen pos// yab yum chags pa'i chags chen la// gus pa (12)chen pos rjes chags pa'i// chags pa chen po sbar du gsol// zhes brjod nas/ slob dpon gyis de ltar gsang ba'i dbang gis bcu gcig kun tu 'od kyi sa chen po thob pa la dbang bas/ rang gzhan gyi snod bcud 'di yid dang ngag gi brjod pa'i rtogs pa las rang bden pas bskyed pa ma yin par yid dang ngag gi brjod pas btags pa bden med rgyu med tsam gyi dkyil 'khor du don gyi dbang thob pa yin pas/ de phyin chad 'byung ba rlung dang sgra dang yi ge rang rgyud du grub pa'i dkyil 'khor las dbang len nod mi bya zhing*/ gal te byas na rtsa ltung brgyad pa dang*/ bcu gsum pa sogs kyis reg par 'gyur ro// gsum pa shes rab ye shes kyi dbang ni/ 'pho ba bcu gnyis kyi spyod pa'i dkar dmar gyi cha bzhu bar nus pa'i rig ma lo bcu gnyis sngar bshad pa'i rgyan gyis brgyan te/ 'dod pa'i yon tan du ma dang bcas te slob dpon la phul nas gsol ba gdab pa ni/ bcom ldan zhi ba chen po kye// rdo rje rnal 'byor ci bzhed pa// mi phyed phyag rgya grub pa po// rdo rje rnal 'byor las byung ba// ji ltar khyod ni bdag nyid che// mnga' bdag bdag la'ang de ltar mdzod// 'khor ba 'dam (13)gyi tshogs nang du// bying ba skyabs med bdag la skyobs// bde gshegs nyid la mngon gyur pa'i// shes rab dbang bskur stsal du gsol// zhes gsol ba btab pas/

slob dpon gyis phyogs bcu'i rdo rje 'chang rnams la slob ma'i ched du sngar bzhin gsol ba gdab par byas nas/ slar slob ma la spro ba dri ba ni/ de lta na ni khyod nyid kyis// sna tshogs yum gyi gtso bo la// bde ba bla med phul byas nas// rang nyid de yi ro myong zhing*// bu khyod de bzhin spro'am ci// zhes pa'i lan du slob mas/ sna tshogs yum gyi gtso bo la// bde ba bla med phul byas te// bdag nyid de yi ro myong zhing*// de ltar mchod byed shin tu spro// zhes lan btab/ de nas slob dpon gyis/ rdo rje sems dpa' gzhan zhig gis// de sras rnams la sgrol ba'i slad// snang ba zhi ba'i spyad pa 'di// chags chen khyod kyis blang bar gyis// de ltar blangs pa'i bde ba gang*// khyod kyis rdzogs sangs rgyas la phul// dkyil 'khor rnams la mchod byas pas// khyod kyis dkyil 'khor mthong bar 'gyur// de bas khyod la de ring 'dir// shes rab thabs las byung (14)ba yi// bde sbyin bya yi bzung bar gyis// rtag tu zung zhig rigs kyi bu// zhes brjod pas/ slob mas/ rdo rje'i bde ba gang gis ni// sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' la// nyer zhi mchod pa rdzogs byas te// bde ba tshim tshim blang bar 'dod// de blangs pas na der 'khod pa'i// dkyil 'khor lha tshogs blta lags na// de bas de ring bdag gis ni// shes rab thabs las byung ba yi// bde ba stsal ba bdag gis bzung*// zhes gsol bas/ slob dpon gyis dam tshig 'bogs pa ni/ bla ma sangs rgyas kun dang mnyam// khyod kyi lus srog btang nas kyang*// bla ma'i zhabs kyi padmar spyod// 'gro kun rdor sems nyid du blta// 'di las 'das par 'gyur pa na// rab zab rdo rje dmyal bar 'gro// skyes pa'i lus kyang mi thob na// mchog gi lus ni ga la thob// de bas khyod kyi srog nyid las// dam tshig shin tu gces par gyis// zhes bsgos nas/

slob dpon gyis phyag rgya'i lag pa g.yas pa nas bzung*/ slob ma'i spyi bor bzhag phyag rgya'i lag pa g.yon pa slob ma'i lag pa g.yas su gtad nas/ slob dpon (15)gyis/ dga' ster gnas ster lha mo ni// sna tshogs gzugs can yid 'ong ma// khyer cig khyer cig sems dpa' che// khyer la mchod pa rtag tu gyis// thabs gzhan dag gis 'tshang mi rgya// 'gro ba gsum 'di dag byed pa// de bas khyod kyis 'di dang ni// nam yang 'bral bar mi bya ste// 'di ni sangs rgyas thams cad kyi// rig pa'i brtul zhugs bla na med// blun po gang zhig 'di spong bas// de la mchog gi dngos grub med// ces pas phyag rgya slob ma la byin te/ slob mas blangs nas/ slob ma bde ba chen po'i rig ma la rjes su chags pa'i dad pa dang gus pa chen po dang phyag rgya nyid kyang slob ma la sbyor ba'i chags pa'i gdung ba chen po'i ye shes kyi 'od zer gyis phyag rgya'i snying khar padma 'dab brgyad kyi dbus su rang byung gi yi ge lnga la ḍā ki ma sngon mo brgyad kyis bskor ba gsal bar snang bar mdzad de/ slob ma la bstan te/ slob dpon yab yum gyi 'di lta bu'i dkyil 'khor du zhugs shig pa'i bkas/ me tog 'dor du gzhug ste/ thig le mi nyams pho brang du// gdung ba'i me tog 'di dor bas// las dang skal ba ro mnyam (16)pa'i// lha mo de la 'bab par shog /ces dor te/ gang la phog pa de lhag pa'i lhar ngo sprad nas/ slar yang slob mas phyag rgya ma la gsol ba gdab par bya ste/ mi 'gyur bde ba'i ye shes che// lhan cig skyes dga'i rang bzhin can// rdzogs sangs rgyas kyi grong khyer mchog /bha ga'i dkyil 'khor 'byed par 'tshal// zhes gsol nas/ phyag rgya mas/ bshang gci dag ni za ba dang*// khrag dang khu ba de bzhin te// sha chen bsten par bu spro'am// bud med rnams la rtag gus dang*// bha ga'i padmar 'o byed par// bu khyod ji ltar spro ba'am smros// zhes pa'i lan du/

lha mo bdag ni cis mi spro// bud med la ni dad pa dang*// khu khrag rnams ni rab tu bza'// bha ga'i padmar 'o bgyid do// zhes brjod pas/ phyag rgya dri zhim po'i chus padma legs par kha phye nas snying kha'i rang byung gi yi ge lnga dang ḍā ki rgya mtsho'i tshogs phab ste/ bha ga'i kha kha gdong gi mkha' dbyings su bzhugs pa slob ma la bstan te/ e ma bdag gi padma 'di// bde ba kun dang yang dag ldan// bde bar gshegs pa thams cad kun// (17)rtag tu 'di dang mi 'bral lo// padma 'di ni chos dbyings yin// sangs rgyas thams cad 'di las byung*// ma lus sems can 'di ru grol// mkha' nang rtsa yi 'khor lo la// padma zhes ni rab tu grags// padma'i nang gi nam mkha' la// 'byung ba bzhi yi rang bzhin las// rang byung mkha' 'gro'i dkyil 'khor gsal// lte ba dang ni ge sar bcas// 'dab ma brgyad kyis rnam par brgyan// ze'u 'bru dbus nas 'byung ba ni// de nyid bdud rtsi dam pa yin// de yi nyon mongs ye sangs rgyas// zhes bstan pa de nyid gsang ba'i reg pas bha ga'i nang gi dkyil 'khor pa'i gzhal bya nyams su myong ba'i sgo nas mthong ste/ slob ma dang phyag rgya lhan cig tu sbyar ba'i phan tshun chags chen ye shes kyi mes spyi bo'i kā li'i phreng ba byang chub kyi sems kyi thig ler zhu ba phab ste/ mgrin par dga' ba/ snying khar mchog dga'/ lte bar dga' bral/ nor bu'i rtser lhan cig skyes pa'i dga' ba'i ye shes nyams su myong rim gyi bha ga'i dkyil 'khor pa mchod pa dgyes dgur rol bar byas pa las 'khor 'das thams cad shes rab ma'i dbyings su thim nas shes rab ma nyid kyis bskyed pas skye 'chis (18)gzhom du med par rtogs pa gsum pa'i dbang bskur ba'i stobs kyis thob pa'i shes rab ye shes kyi dbang dngos yin par ngo shes su gzhug nas/ slob dpon gyis de ltar shes rab ye shes kyi dbang gis bcu gnyis pa ma chags padma can gyi sa chen po thob pa la dbang bas/

rang gzhan gyi snod bcud 'di sa bon kun gzhi'i khams lnga rdzas kyi thig le nus pa las rang bden pas bskyed pa min par dkar dmar mun gsum gyi thig le'i sa bon gyi 'du 'phro rtog pas brtags tsam gyi sku gsung thugs rdo rje'i khams gsum gyi dkyil 'khor du don gyi dbang thob pa yin pas/ da phyin chad mi gtsang ba srid pa'i sa bon gyi khams dang snyigs ma'i thig le'i dkyil 'khor las dbang len nod mi bya zhing*/ gal te byas na rtsa ltung lnga pa dang brgyad pa dang bcu bzhi pa sogs reg par 'gyur ro// bzhi pa tshig gi dbang ni/ bden pa bzhi la thabs shes kyi bde chen brgyad dam yon tan gyi bdag nyid kyi rten byed pa'i byang chub kyi sems bzhu bar nus pa'i rig ma lo brgyad ma sngar bshad pa'i rgyan gyis brgyan nas 'dod pa'i yon tan du ma dang bcas te slob dpon la phul nas gsol ba gdab pa ni/ sangs rgyas kun gyi gsang ba gsum// (19)dbyer med gcig tu gyur pa yi// bla na med pa bzhi pa'i dbang*// da lta nyid du bstan du gsol// zhes brjod nas/ slob dpon gyi phyogs bcu'i rdo rje 'chang rnams la slob ma'i ched du sngar bzhin gsol ba gdab par byas nas/ slob dpon gyis slob ma la 'di skad du gdams par bya ste/ dga' ba dga' bral mchog dga' dang*// lhan skyes dga' ba rab 'byung ste// don dam lhan skyes der brjod do// bha gar ling ga rab bcug la// byang chub sems srung mi 'jigs pa// srid pa gsum po ma lus pa// sangs rgyas sku gsung thugs bsgom bya// rang gzhan don ni ma lus 'byung*// gal te bdud rtsi shor ba na// byang sems rang lces blang bar bya// zhes legs par bshad nas/ slar yang slob dpon la phyag byas nas/ zla nyi sgra gcan la brten pa'i// byang sems bde ba ma lus pa// bzhu zhing nyams su myong nus pa'i// dngos grub bdag gis thob lags kyang*// da dung snang mun snang bral ba'i// sa bon bde myong phyag rgya stsol// zhes lan gsum gsol ba btab/

de nas/ slob dpon nyid kyis dang por rig ma lo brgyad ma la snyoms (20)par zhugs nas dga' bzhi'i ye shes kyis rgyud tshim zhing mgu ba'i ye shes kyi 'od zer gyis phyag rgya'i lte bar rang byung gi yi ge lnga'i mthar ḍā ki ma ser mo drug bcu rtsa bzhis bskor ba gsal bar snang bar mdzad de/ slob ma la bstan nas slob dpon yab yum gyis 'di lta bu'i dkyil 'khor du zhugs shig pa'i bkas me tog 'dor du gzhug ste/ 'byung ba rang grol pho brang du// mi 'jigs me tog 'di dor bas// las dang skal bar ldan pa yi// lha mo de la 'bab par shog /ces dor te gang la phog pa de lhag pa'i lhar ngo sprad nas/ slar yang slob mas bla ma yab yum la gsol ba gdab pa ni/ gzhom du med pa'i bde ba mchog /cha med cha 'das bcu drug cha// sangs rgyas kun gyi bde ba che// e waṃ rang bzhin myong bar 'tshal// zhes gsol nas/ kha dog gser dang mtshungs pa'i rig ma rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa'i phyag rgya la 'khyud cing snyoms par zhugs nas/ der nyams su myong ba'i bde ba skad cig ma bcu drug gis ches phra ba'i 'dzag sgrib kyi bden bzhi log zhugs bcu drug gi sgrib pa'i gnas ngan len gcod par ngo sprod de/ slob dpon gyis/ nyon cig bu khyod dbang gi don// (21)dga' ba bcu drug mtshan nyid can// sems can kun gyi bde ba ni// thun mong du ni gnas pa'o// 'dod chags kyis ni yid dkrugs pas// dga' ba dang po zhes su bshad// shes rab yan lag 'khyud pa yi// dpral bar gnas pa'i byang chub sems// mchog gi dga' ba gnyis pa'o// de nas 'khrig pa'i dbang gis ni// 'dod chags me ni rang 'bar 'gyur// sbar bas thig le 'dzag pa ni// khyad par dga' ba gsum pa'o// lus ngag sems kyi thig le ni// tha char bzhi pa 'byung ba'i dus// rang rig skad cig gang yin pa// lhan cig skyes pa bzhi pa'o// bzhi pa de nyid lus dang ngag

/sems dang ye shes thig le'o// bzhi bzhi dbye bas bcu drug pa// chags bral la sogs chags pa che// kha dog sna tshogs 'bar ba'i 'od// rdo rje skyil krung rdzogs sangs rgyas// sangs rgyas spyod pa'i tshul 'dzin pa// rnam pa kun ldan rnam pa med// bcu drug phyed phyed thig le can// cha med cha las 'das pa ste// bsam gtan gzhi yi rtse mo can// zhes rdo rje 'chang chen pos 'khor 'das kyi mtha' gnyis las mi gnas (22)pa'i myang 'das kyi bde ba chen po mngon du byed pa'i tshul gyis gsungs la/ de yang dga' ba dang po gsum ni gtso bor dbang dang po gsum gyi ye shes sku gsung thugs kyi dkyil 'khor gyi dngos grub pha ma'i rgyud phyin gyis 'grub pa'i rdo rje sems dpa'i go 'phang yin la/ lhan cig skyes dga'i ye shes mtshan nyid pa ni dbang gsum pa'i dus su mi 'byung bas/ gsum pa'i bde dga'i ye shes de nyid kyi lhan cig byed rkyen du byas pas/ bzhi pa'i dus su dga' ba bzhi pa lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes de nyid smin par 'gyur la/ de nyid kyi gnyis med rgyud kyi phul du dbyung du med pa'i sangs rgyas mngon du byed pas/ dbang 'di ni ye shes kyi dkyil 'khor gyi dngos grub nyid thob par byed la/ ye shes kyi dkyil 'khor nyid kyi dbang du mdzad nas/ sku gsung thugs ye shes kyi bde ba bcu drug mngon du mdzad pa'i dbang ni/ bzhi pa shes rab ye shes chen po'i dbang zhes brjod la/ de nyid kyi phyir/ bzhi pa'i dbang bskur ba la tshig tsam las ma gtogs phyag rgya la brten nas dbang bskur ba med par gsungs pa yang drang ba'i don gyi rgyud kyi bshad pa yin la/ 'dir phyag rgya la brten nas bzhi pa shes rab ye shes mngon du (23)byas te 'khor 'das thams cad 'byung ba'i gzhi srid zhi mnyam pa nyid e waṃ dbyer med par gyur pas gang spyod 'gro ba'i don du dpyad pa'i rig pa brtul zhugs chen por spyod pa la dbang ba nyid kyis/

rgyud kyi nges pa'i don mthar thug pa bla ma'i man ngag gi dbang du byas pa yin no zhes ngo sprad do// de ltar don dam ye shes byang chub sems kyi dkyil 'khor du rang byung yi ge lnga'i bzhi pa'i dbang gis bcu gsum rdo rje 'dzin pa'i sa chen po thob pa la dbang bas/ 'khor 'das kyi kun gzhi rang byung ye shes lnga'i dkyil 'khor rang bden pas bskyed pa min par rtog pas btags tsam gyis chos dbyings sgyu ma tsam gyis spros bral 'khrul med 'khor 'das rang grol gyi dkyil 'khor du don gyi dbang thob pa yin pas/ da phyin chad 'dus byas bcos ma bslu ba'i rdzun snang 'khrul pa'i dkyil 'khor las dbang len nod mi bya zhing*/ gal te byas na shes bya thun mong min pa'i dbang du byas pa'i rtsa ltung dgu pa dang bcu gcig pas reg par 'gyur ro zhes brda sprad nas/ slob ma nyid kyi lus dang longs spyod bu chung ma sgo gsum dge bar bcas pa sems can thams cad kyi don du rdo rje slob dpon la dbul lo// de nas bza' (24)ba dang btung ba dang bldag pa dang bca' bar bya ba'i tshogs gsog pa'i rdzas de dag sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga'i bdag nyid kyi sbyang rtogs sbar bar byas pa de dag rdo rje slob dpon yab yum gtso bor gyur pa'i rdo rje'i mched lcam dag gis dgyes dgur longs spyod cing rdo rje'i glu gar sogs kyis mnyes par byas na tha mal gyi chos thams cad kyis dben pa'i ngang nas bsngo ba dang smon lam la sogs pa'i las shis par bya'o// gnyis pa ni/ 'di lta bu'i dbang bzhi bskur nas lam sgom tshul ni/ ci bskyed rim gyi dbang du byas pa'am/ rdzogs rim gyi dbang du byas pa yin nam/ las dang po pa longs spyod la 'jug pa'i dbang du byas pa yin nam/ rgyu'i theg pa'i dag pa pa zhig sngags lam nas 'jug pa'i dbang du byas pa yin nam/ mdo sngags kyi lam 'og ma 'og ma'i sangs rgyas gnyis med rgyud kyi sangs rgyas kyi ched du 'jug pa'i dbang du byas pa gang yin zhes rtog na/

de'i phyir brjod par bya ste/ 'di la ni/ ༈ rin po che karma pakshi'i rgya mtsho skor gyi gsung rab las 'byung ste/ de yang rje nyid kyis mdzad pa'i mkha' 'gro yid bzhin nor bu'i khrid gzhung gi dgongs pa ltar na/ theg pa rim pa (25)dgu la dbang po rtul pos rim gyis 'jug pa dang*/ dbang 'bring theg pa bzhi pa nas 'jug pa dang*/ dbang rnon theg pa bdun pa nas 'jug pa dang*/ ches dbang rnon theg pa dgu pa nyid nas 'jug tu rung la/ 'di lta ni gsang sngags snga 'gyur gyi dbang du byas pa yin ste/ de yang khrid gzhung der/ ji skad du/ chos kyi sku rdo rje 'chang chen po rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma la bshad/ de rnams kyis mkha' 'gro'i dbang phyug gi skur gyur pa'i grub pa thob pa'i rnal 'byor pho mo ji snyed byon pa de thams cad mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho sku bzhi ngo sprod yid bzhin nor bu 'di ni rgyud chen po sgyu 'phrul dra ba/ mdo chen po dgongs pa 'dus pa/ lung chen po a nu yo ga dwags po bka' brgyud kyi gdams ngag snyan rgyud du/ khrid bka' sum cu tham pa/ khrid phran brgya rtsa brgyad kyi snying po'ang 'di nyid yin pa'i phyir na/ zhes 'byung ba'i/ khrid tshul 'di gsang sngags gsar mar ma zad gsang sngags snga 'gyur gyi dgongs par yang 'grub ste/ dbang po shin tu rnon po sdig pa ches che ba'ang lam gzhan sngon du ma song bar ni bka' rdzogs pa (26)chen po nyid kyis grol bar nus pa chos 'di'i khyad chos yin pa'i phyir/ ji skad du/ rdzogs pa chen po nang thos na nang grol/ nub thos na nub grol/ skal ldan las 'phro can la sgom mi dgos/ gzhi thog tu 'du bya ba med par rang grol/ rtsa ba byung rgyal/ rtse mo thob rgyal/ zhes 'byung ba'i phyir/ des na snga 'gyur gyi theg pa'i yang rtse gsum las/ ma hā a nu a ti gsum yang gsang sngags phyi 'gyur ltar na pha ma dang*/ gnyis med kyi rgyud gsum du bzhag pas/

rdzogs pa chen po'i theg pa dang gnyis med dus kyi 'khor lo'i rgyud gnyis gang bstun na gnad gcig tu 'bab pa'i phyir/ dbang po ches rno ba theg pa rim pa dgu pa dang*/ gnyis med dus kyi 'khor lo'i rgyud nyid nas 'jug tu rung ba'i phyir/ gnyis med rgyud dus kyi 'khor lo'ang gong du bshad pa ltar dbang po ches rno ba 'jig rten pa'i rdo rje slob ma'i dbang sngon du ma song bar yang 'jig rten las 'das pa gong ma chen po'i dbang bskur du btub par gsungs pa ji lta ba de bzhin du lugs 'dir yang rdzogs pa chen po'i theg pa'am gnyis med dus kyi 'khor (27)lo'i dbang du mdzad pa'i thugs rje chen po rgyal ba rgya mtsho dang rdo rje phag mo zhal gcig pa'i dbang gong ma 'di nyid bya bar gsungs pa dus kyi 'khor lo'i dgongs par 'gro tshul yang*/ khrid gzhung der/ gsang sngags kyi snying po/ pha ma gnyis med kyi rgyud gsum las/ pha rgyud kyis rtsa gtso bor bstan/ ma rgyud kyis rlung thig gtso bor bstan/ gnyis med rgyud las gsum ga gtso bor bstan pa dus kyi 'khor lo yin te/ de yang*/ so sor spang dang bsam gtan dang*// srog stsol de bzhin 'dzin pa dang*// rjes su dran pa'i ting nge 'dzin// sbyor ba yan lag drug tu bshad// ces 'byung bas/ lus ngag yid gsum rang sar rang rig tu 'du bya ba med par grol ba'i ched kyi/ dug gsum dag pa'i mun khang rim pa gsum par ma rtogs log rtog the tshom gsum gyi pho mo ma ning gi rlung gsum so sor bsdus nas bsam gtan gyi rlung de nyid kyi bdag po'o// rnam shes rig bcas rig med/ rig pa dbyer med la dbang thob par byed la/ dbang thob pa na srog rtsol gyis nang gi rtsa gsum 'khor lo bzhi'i 'khor ba'i rang byung gi (28)yi ge lnga/ de las 'phros pa'i kā li sum cu ā li bcu drug gi rang sgra dbyings su thim zhing*/

'dzin pas myang 'das kyi rang byung gi yi ge lnga 'khor bcas kyi sgra dbyangs 'gog pa med par mdzad nas rjes dran gyi sgra snyan pa'i bde bas yid la chags pa 'bar bar byas nas ting nge 'dzin gyis/ chags pa des bskul ba'i bde ba chen po las sems gzhan du g.yo ba med par gnas pa ni theg pa dgu'i dmar khrid kyi snying po mthar thug pa'o// zhes 'byung la/ gnad 'di lta bu khong du ma chud par bod kha cig /rje nā ro pa dus kyi 'khor lo pa chen po yin pa la/ rje mar pa la de'i chos kyi bka' med do zhes smra ba ni/ mkhas grub mtshur phu 'jam dbyangs rin po ches/ thub pa'i mdzad srol kun dga' bo// mar pa'i mdzad srol nged lags mod// rgyus med log ltas ci ltar rtog /ces 'byung ba ltar yin pas/ rje btsun mar pa'i bka' brgyud 'di la ni bcom ldan 'das rdo rje 'chang chen po'i pha ma dang*/ gnyis med kyi rgyud gsum gyi bka' ma lus pa yongs su rdzogs par bzhugs pa yin te/ de nyid kyi phyir bshad (29)ma thag pa'i dbang bskur ba'i lhag pa'i lha yang rgyal ba rgya mtsho dang rdo rje phag mo la bya dgos par gsungs pa'i thugs rje chen po rgyal ba rgya mtsho dang rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'ang pha ma'i rgyud nyi tshe ba ma yin par gnyis med dus kyi 'khor lo'i rgyud kyi thugs rje chen po dang rdo rje rnal 'byor mar shes dgos te/ khrid gzhung der/ lag len thams cad thugs rje chen po rgyal ba rgya mtsho dang*/ rje btsun ma zhal gcig ma/ lha lnga/ rang byung gi yi ge lnga'i gzugs sku'i gdams ngag rnams la sogs lag len bsnyen bsgrub bya zhing*/ rje btsun ma'i bstod 'bum dkyil chog rnams dang*/ rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i las byang rnams gcig yin pa'i phyir na tshogs mchod dbang bskur gang byed kyang dbyangs gdangs legs par bslabs nas cho ga rgyas bsdus ci rigs par byas te/ sngags kyi lag cha/

ḍa ma ru/ rnga gling bu sba dung*/ rkang dung la sogs thams cad tshogs par bya zhing*/ chos spyod byed do cog nyin mtshan med dpon slob rnams kyis bkrol zhing*/ mos gus gsol 'debs/ ma ṇi padme'i dbyangs rgyun chad med par bya zhing*/ bdag gzhan thams cad la byin gyis brlabs pa rgyun chad med par (30)byas na snang srid byin gyis rlob cing khams gsum dbang du 'du bar 'byung ngo*// zhes 'byung ba nyid kyis shes pa'i phyir/ mkha' 'gro yid bzhin nor bu'i smin grol gyi khrid gzhung 'di ni theg dgu'i khrid kyi lus yongs rdzogs kyi theg pa dgu pa gnyis med rgyud kho na'i lag len rnam dag yin pa'i phyir ro// 'o na theg pa dgu pa 'di la theg pa'i rim pa snga ma snga ma sngon du ma song ba rnams kyang 'di nyid nas 'jug tu btub pa de ci'i khyad yin snyam na/ gang zag gi dbang po ches rno ba/ theg pa'i yang rtse la dad brtson shes rab gsum gyi dge ba'i rtsa bas rigs sad par byas pa'i mthu las yin te/ de lta'i shes rab kyi dge ba des yul gyi gnas tshul ci lta bu zhig rtogs dgos sam snyam na/ khrid gzhung der/ a e waṃ ma ya'i yi ge lnga po de nyid 'khor 'das thams cad 'byung ba'i gzhi las ma rig ma rtogs pa'i gang zag theg brgyad phyin la/ gnas pas sgrub spong bsgyur bcos kyi las du ma byas pas spros bcas su song bas kun rdzob bslu chos kyi chos kyi rten 'brel las yig lnga dug lnga 'byung lnga lam rgyud lnga la sogs pa snang zhing*/ ci ltar bzang yang (31)a nu phyin gyi rigs lnga ye shes lnga 'char ba yin la/ de thams cad bcos pa'i yi ge lnga dang bskyed pa'i yi ge lnga ste/ kun brtags a 'thas can gyi dbang du byas pa yin te/ 'di lta bu'i gdul bya la rdo rje 'chang gi theg brgyad kyi chos rdzun pa du ma zhig gsung bar snang ba'i phyir/ rgyud las/ nga yis rtsed mo byas pa la// byis pa rnams ni a thang chad// ces 'byung la/

yig lnga de nyid la theg pa dgu pa la gnas pa'i gang zag gi blang dor bsgyur bcos kyi las gang byas na snga ma ltar 'gyur dogs pa shes rab chen pos rig gnas de lta'i las gang yang ma phog par byas pas spros bral don dam bden pa bslu med kyi chos kyi rten 'brel gyi rang babs chen po las/ yig lnga sku lnga gsung lnga thugs lnga yon tan lnga dang phrin las lnga sogs rang grol gyi skyed sdud med par gzhi thog nas rang grol gyi sangs rgyas las sgrib pa spang du med/ ye shes gsar du thob pa med par sangs rgyas pa ste/ dug lnga dgag tu med/ ye shes lnga skyed du med pa'i rdzogs rim chen po mthar phyin pa'i tshe/ rdo rje 'chang gi rgyud las/ yang bskyed/ yang bshig /yang bsgrub/ yang 'gog /yang spang*/ yang len/ la dgu/ lung dgu/ (32)lam dgu bgrod pa'i theg pa mu stegs rtag chad ma 'das so// zhes 'byung la/ 'di ltar shes na ye gdod ma'i kun gzhi chos dbyings dkyil 'khor du shar ba na dbang chen po der thob/ bskyed rdzogs thams cad der rdzogs par lhun gyis grub pa na spros bcas kyi bskyed rdzogs thams cad rdzun mdud rang sar grol ba na sgrib gsum bag nyal sbyang byed kyi mtshan ma rdzas kyi dbang gzhi bsnyen sgrub bzhi thams cad kyang mig dag pa la skra shad ltar dmigs su med pa na rang byung yig lnga'i dug lnga spang dgos pa ma yin te/ de lta'i dus sangs rgyas kyi spyan gyis btsal kyang dug lnga'i rang byung yi ge rnyed pa ma yin pa'i phyir/ zhes dgongs so// rin po che karma pas mkha' 'gro yid bzhin nor bu'i dbang mchog bka' rgya ma las/ sngags 'chang rang byung rdo rje'i khyad chos/ rmongs pa kun gyis mi shes pa'i zab don ni/ rang byung yi ge lnga la rtogs na rigs lnga yab yum lnga dpa' bo lnga ḍā ki lnga/ de las dbyangs gsal gyi sgra brjod kyi 'du 'phrod zad pa med pa'i dkyil 'khor/

de yang ā li bcu drug las ḍā ki bcu drug /kā li (33)so gnyis las ḍā ki so gnyis de thabs shes drug cu rtsa bzhi ste dkyil 'khor mtha' yas pa thams cad kyang dngos po rang bden pas dngos po dang bden pa bskyed nas byung bar min par rten 'brel rtags tsam bcos min gyi rang gar byung la/ yi ge de las ma rtogs pa dug lnga lam rgyud lnga'i rgyu 'bras kyang de nyid las rang 'khrul du song ba ma gtogs/ ma rtogs dug lnga dang rgyud lnga'i 'khor ba'i yi ge'i rgyu 'bras kyang gshis rang bden par med la/ de ltar bzung bas theg brgyad phyin chad mgo bskor drang don gyi theg par shes par mdzod/ ces gsungs pas kyang shes par 'gyur ro// 'o na gnyis med kyi skal can la dang po nas dbang gong ma'i gong ma nas bskur nas rdzogs rim zab gsal nyid nas khrid pas sa bcu lam lnga bgrod pa'i tshul 'di rje sgam po pas phyag rgya chen po'i skal ldan dag la rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor la sogs par dbang ma bskur bar/ snang srid ye dag phyag rgya chen po'i dkyil 'khor du ma bcos spang blang med par dbang bskur zhing de don ngo 'phrod pa 'byams klas su byung ba dag gis mi dge ba'i spyod pa ltar spyad pa thams cad sngags kyi spyod pa mchog tu 'gro ba dper na/ 'bro (34)dmar g.yu'i spyod pa rje sgam po pa'i rnam thar nas 'byung ba bzhin yin la/ de lta'i dbang du mdzad nas sdig chen skal ldan la phyi'i dbang dang bskyed rim la ma brten par rdzogs rim nyid la dang po nas khrid rung ba 'di gnyis med rgyud du ma zad/ pha rgyud gsang ba 'dus pa nas kyang sbas don gyi tshul du bstan pa yin te/ dpal ldan zla bas 'dus pa'i 'grel pa sgron gsal las/ ji skad du/ theg mchog 'di la 'grub par 'gyur zhes bya ba ni rdo rje theg pa chen po bla na med pa'o// mchog ni rin po che'i gang zag ste/

'di nyid kyi 'gro ba nas theg pa mchog ste/ de las 'grub par 'gyur ba'o// sems can mtshams med ces bya ba la sogs pa la pha dang ma dang dgra bcom pa gsod pa dang sangs rgyas kyi sku 'jig pa dang*/ dam pa'i chos spang ba bya ba'i las lngas ni 'chi ba'i dus byas ma thag tu dmyal bar lhung bar 'gyur bas na mtshams med pa ste nye bar mtshon pa 'dis ni mtshams med pa zhes bya ba'i sgra ni byed pa la 'jug go /sogs pa zhes bya ba'i sgra ni mtshams med pa dang nye ba rnams bzung ngo*// sdig pa chen po byed pa zhes bya ba ni dge slong gi rtsa ba bzhi'i ltung ba byung ba ta la'i (35)mgo bcad pa ltar sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa las nyams na sems can dmyal ba na gzhol ba ste/ de rnams kyang 'dir bla ma'i drin gyis rdzogs pa'i rim pa thob nas 'grub par 'gyur zhing sangs rgyas nyid thob par 'gyur na rigs ngan pa la sogs pa lta ci smos zhes de'i nyes pa las 'da' ba'o// de ltar snod dang snod ma yin pa ltos pa med par don mdzad pa na theg pa che ba'i bdag nyid gsal bar ston pa yin no// zhes 'byung ba nyid don la gnas pa de nyid kyi phyir/ grub chen sha ba ri dbang phyug dang*/ dpal nags kyi rin chen dag gi zhal lung grub chen ā nanta pā dhus bkod par/ grub pa'i dbang phyug ba na ratne'i zhal snga nas ni/ dkyil 'khor du yang ma bcug dbang yang ma bskur/ bslab pa dang sdom pa la mi gnas pa'i slob ma tha mal pa snod dang mi ldan pa la khrid btab chog ste/ ci'i phyir zab mo'i khrid 'di kho na yin pa'i phyir/ zhes mngon sum du gsung ba thos zhes 'chad gda' la/ des na khrid don nyid rnal mar ngo 'phrod na dbang dang dam sdom thams cad kyi don grub pa'i phyir/ dpal phag mo grub pa lta bus kyang 'jig rten gsum gyi mgon po 'bri gung pa (36)sogs slob ma ches che ba'i mchog rnams la/ rdul tshon dang ras bris bkram nas dbang sdom nod pa skad ma mdzad par/

zhal mthong ba tsam gyis dbang don bskyed par mdzad pa dang*/ rgyal ba'i dbang po karma pa chos grags rgya mtsho'i zhal snga nas kyis slob ma'i mchog rnams la spros bcas kyi dbang sogs bskur bar mi mdzad par gsung khrid btab pa tsam gyis rang byung ye shes kyi dbang don skyes pa grangs med pa grub pa thob pa zam ma chad par byung ba nyid de bka' brgyud rin po che 'di la gtam du grags pa la'ang*/ 'gro mgon gyi drung du gling ras kyis/ sdom pa zhu ma myong*/ dbang zhu ma myong*/ dmigs pa zhu ma myong bar byin rlabs kyi stobs kyis chu bo gaṅgā tshun la phyag chen gyi rtogs pa khong mtho zhes grags pa lta bu'o// don 'di la deng sang bod kyi sngags par 'bod pa kha cig ltar/ rdul mtshon gyi dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur ba'i snod ldan min par btags yod ma bcos pa'i dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur kyang dbang mi thob bo zhes smra ba dag rgyang sring bar byas pa yin no// des na rdzogs rim nyid kyis brda thabs tsam gyi smin grol las/ spros bcas rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor sogs (37)la ma brten par rdo rje 'chang gi go 'phang thob pa 'di ni sngon rgya gar gyi grub thob phal che ba'i rnam thar la snang ste/ tsa mi lo tsa'i grub thob brgya rtsa'i rnam thar las/ grub thob lu yi pa'ang rgyal bu zhig yin pa rgyal srid spangs nas yul gzhan du phyin pa chang tshong gi gtso bo ma mkha' 'gro ma zhig gis/ rgyal bu la bltas nas khyod la 'khor lo bzhi sogs kyi dri ma dag 'dug kyang da dung rigs kyi nga rgyal ba'i rtog pa yungs kar tsam 'dug zer/ der rgyal bu la mkha' 'gro mas zas ngan pa byin pa ma blangs pas mkha' 'gro ma khros nas zas la bzang ngan gyi rnam rtog ma spangs na byang chub ga la rnyed zer bas/ rgyal bus nya pas gaṅgā nas nya bsad pa'i sgyu lto la lo bcu gnyis bsten nas rnam rtog sbyangs pas grub pa thob ste lo yi pa zhes bya bar grags zhes pa dang*/

yang slob dpon shanti pa yul dbus nas sing ga gling gi rgyal pos sing ga gling du spyan drangs pas lam khar ri rtse gcig tu mi gcig gis tog tses ri brko yin 'dug zer bas slob dpon khyed 'di tsam du ri brko ba ci yin byas pas/ rgyal po ngan pas yul du sdod ma bcug pas 'dir sdod pa lags mod zhus (38)pas/ slob dpon gyi log pa'i brtson 'grus sogs spangs nas phar phyin drug bsgom pa'i tshigs su bcad pa gcig tog tses sa brko ba dang sbyar te gdams pas/ des lo bcu gnyis su de'i sa rko ba dang don sgom pa sgrags pas phyag rgya chen po mchog gi dngos grub thob nas/ lha'i dbang po rgya sbyin sogs kyis bsnyen bkur byas pa na rang gi slob dpon gang du bzhugs mngon shes kyis brtags pas/ de nas zla ba drug 'gro dgos pa'i ma ga dhar bzhugs par dgongs nas/ slob dpon sku drin che bas bka' drin gsob pa'i bsnyen bkur gyi ched du bi ka ma lar slob dpon bzhugs pa'i nam mkha' la tog tse pa'i ye shes kyi lus kyis phyag dang bskor ba sogs kyi bsnyen bkur mdzad pas slob dpon dpon slob kyis ma mthong*/ phyis sa la babs nas rnam smin gyi lus kyis slob dpon gyi zhabs la phyag byas pas/ slob dpon gyis khyod su yin gsungs pas/ slob ma lags mod zhus pas/ nga la slob ma dpag tu med pa yod pas ngos ma zin gsungs pas/ tog tse ba'i rgyu mtshan zhus pas/ slob dpon gyis khyod la yon tan ci yod gsungs pas/ tog tse pas bdag gis phar phyin drug gi don la bsgoms pas phyag rgya chen po'i dngos grub thob zhus pas/ 'o na khyod (39)sgrub pa byas ngas bshad pa byas pas/ bdag gi yon tan kyang de rgas nas brjed 'dug pas khyod kyi dngos grub kyi yon tan gyi chos kyang bdag la ston gsungs pas/ slob dpon tog tse pas dben pa'i gnas su slob dpon shanti pa la phyag rgya chen po'i yon tan gyi rdzu 'phrul du ma bstan pas de nyid byin rlabs kyi gdams ngag tu song nas/

slob dpon shanti pas kyang lo bcu gnyis su bsgoms pas phyag rgya chen po mchog gi dngos grub thob skad de/ 'di lta bu'i chos tshul mtha' yas pas deng sang kha cig ltar rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor zhig lhar mos sgom gyi bum chus khrus kyi cho ga ma byas par rgyud smin cing grol ba'i phyag rgya chen po'i ye shes bskyed mi nus so zhes smra ba de dag kha rog re sdod par ma byas sam smras pa/ chos zab don la 'jigs pa med pa yi// dbang rnon skal ldan rjes su bzung ba'i tshul// karma pakshi'i bzhed don ji lta bar// ye shes mkha' 'gro'i man ngag ji bzhin du// legs par phyes la chos 'di skyong rnams kyis// legs par dgyes pa'i bde des sgrub brgyud mchog /gang 'dir bzhugs so cog gi rgyud nyid las// mngon par rtogs pa'i byin rlabs 'jug gyur cig /(40)ces so// gnyis pa grol bar byed pa'i lam bsgom tshul la sngon 'gro/ dngos gzhi/ rjes gsum/ dang po la/ ci byed thar pa'i lam du 'gro ched skyabs 'gro sems bskyed kyi man ngag /sdig sgrib dag par byed pa rdo rje sems dpa'i sgom bzlas/ tshogs gnyis yongs su rdzogs par byed pa maṇḍal gyi bya ba/ byin rlabs myur du 'jug byed bla ma'i rnal 'byor ro// dang po ni/ stan bde bar lus bcos te 'dug nas/ sems can thams cad bde ba dang phrad 'dod kyi byams pa/ sdug bsngal dang bral 'dod kyi snying rje/ bde ba dang ldan pa la dga' ba/ chags sdang med par kun la snyoms pas phan par sems pa'i btang snyoms te/ de lta'i blos drangs nas ma rgan 'gro ba 'di thams cad la bdag gi rdo rje 'chang gi go 'phang gi sgo nas phan gdags par bya ba la dang por rang re'i rdo rje 'chang gi go 'phang thob par bya ba'i sems bskyed par bya ba de'i dang por de ltar sems can thams cad kyi skyabs gcig de nyid la bdag nyid de'i dngos por 'gyur ba'i ched du bdag gzhan mkha' mnyam thams cad gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa'i skyabs zhu bar bya'o snyam pa'i 'dun pa drag pos/

rang gi smin mtshams kyi mdun gyi nam mkhar rin po che'i (41)khri seng ges btegs pa'i steng du/ pad dkar dang nyi ma'i gdan la/ sangs rgyas dkon mchog gi ngo bo dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rdo rje sems dpa'i rnam pa can sku mdog sngon po rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pa/ rus pa dang rin po che'i rgyan sna tshogs kyis brgyan pa/ dar gyi stod g.yogs dang*/ ga shal dang smad g.yogs grol bas bklubs pa/ rdo rje dkyil krung gis bzhugs pa'i pang par/ yum rdo rje rnal 'byor ma dmar mo gri gug dang thod pa can phyag rgya lnga dang ldan pa/ nu ma dang bha ga sbeg cing dbu skra grol bas sku rgyab non cing thod skam lngas dbu rgyan pa/ padma'i skyil dkrung gis bde bar 'khyud pa'i steng gi cha la brgyud pa'i bla ma rnams dang*/ sku'i rgyab tu rin po che'i khri gdan gdugs rgyal mtshan gnam yol mtha' yas par bla mas bstan bya'i dam chos stong nyid snying rje dbyer med kyi rang bzhin glegs bam gyi rnam par bzhugs pa/ sku'i g.yas g.yon du khri gdan sogs bshams ma thag par 'gyur med bde ba'i thugs can gyi dge 'dun gyi ngo bo/ dpa' bo dang mkha' 'gro ma'i tshogs khyim pa dang rab tu byung ba'i tshul sna tshogs pas bzhugs pa/ 'og tu khri gdan sngar ltar (42)la dam nyams dgra bgegs bsgral ba'i ro gdan gyi steng du dkon mchog gsum ga'i ngo bo bla ma mgon po dbyer med pa'i bdag nyid dpal ye shes kyi mgon po ber nag can lcam dral rang rang gi mngon rtogs nas 'byung ba ltar gsal zhing*/ sku'i mdun du phyi nang gsang ba de kho na'i mchod pa rab 'byams sprin phung ltar 'phro bar gyur cing dkon mchog gsum sogs mchod yul dang*/ mchod bya'i rdzas kyi gnas steng bar 'og gsum gyi cha la/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ gi 'od kyis sangs rgyas byang sems thams cad kyi bde stong dbyer med kyi bcud mchog spyan drangs te bstim pas/

mchod yul mchod rdzas thams cad sngar las mtshar sdug 'od du chags par gyur te/ rab tu spro ba dang bcas te phyi'i mchod pa 'bul ba ni/ ngag tu/ 'gro kun re re'ang mkha' khyab zhing rdul gyi// lus can mdzes ma khang bzang mar gyur te// khang bzang yid 'ong mkha' mnyam 'phro gyur pas// skyabs gnas dkon mchog gsum po mchod par bgyid// de bzhin du rigs bsgre ste/ rta babs/ bsil khang*/ khrus khang*/ sro khang*/ ldum ra/ skyed tshal/ gdan khri/ bla re/ gdugs mdzes/ rgyal mtshan/ ba dan/ rnga (43)yab/ bsil yab/ khrus chab/ mchod yon/ zhabs bsil/ zhal bsil/ 'thor 'thung*/ me tog /bdug spos/ snang gsal/ dri mchog /zhal zas/ rol mo/ sku 'khrus/ na bza'/ rgyan mchog /gzugs mdzes/ sgra dbyangs/ dri bzang*/ ro mchog /reg bya/ gzims mal/ bang mdzod/ gter mchog /lo tog /rdzing bu/ ba mchog /dpag ljon/ bzhon pa/ rtsed 'jo/ grong khyer dang*/ grong brdal/ sman ljongs/ rgya mtsho/ ri gling*/ 'khor lor/ nor bu/ btsun mo/ blon po/ glang po// rta mchog /dmag dpon/ 'khor g.yog ces nye bar gang ba kho nas mchod par bya'o// nang gi tshogs kyi 'khor lo'i mchod pa ni/ yaṃ las rlung*/ raṃ las me/ kaṃ las mi mgo'i sgyed bu gsum gyi steng du a las ye shes kyi ka pā la yangs shing rgya che ba'i dbus su hūm̐ las dri chu hūm̐ gis mtshan pa/ shar lho nub byang rnams su bhruṃ aṃ dzriṃ khaṃ las dri chen rakta khu ba klad pa yi ge de dag gis mtshan pa/ de bzhin (44)du dbus dang phyogs bzhir go ku da ha na las ba lang khyi glang po rta mi'i sha rang rang gi yi ges mtshan pa/ de las rlung g.yos me sbar bdud rtsi bkol/ oṃ āḥhūṃ gis sku gsung thugs kyi bdud rtsir gyur/ de nas oṃ āḥhūm̐ zhes mtheb srin gyis blangs te mchod do// de nas rang gi snying ga nas rang gi sems ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ma sku mdog dmar mo gri thod can gcer bu zhig byung ste/

rang lus 'di ri rab tsam du byin gyis brlabs nas gri gug gis smin mtshams nas thod pa sgor mor bregs pa'i gan kyal du bsgyel ba'i nang du lus thams cad gtubs shing bcug ste/ oṃ āḥ hūm̐ gis sku gsung thugs kyi bdud rtsi chen por gyur nas/ slar mchod yul rnams kyi thugs ka nas ro rdo rje ma phyag du ye shes kyi thod mchog bsnams pa dpag tu med pa dang*/ rang sems rdo rje rnal 'byor ma dang dbyer med du gyur pas bdud rtsi chen po de nyid nas bcus te/ dpal ldan bla ma dam pa skyabs gnas rin po che gsum la dgyes dgur bstab pas tshim pa chen pos sngar las kyang bkrag mdangs shin tu gsal bas bdag la mnyes pa chen po rjes su chags (45)pas 'bral mi shes par thugs rjes 'dzin par bsam mo// gsang ba snyoms par 'jug pa'i mchod pa ni/ bdag sogs mkha' mnyam gyi sems can thams cad kyi nang rig 'gyur med ye shes kyi khams can gyi lha mo sna tshogs yum gcer bu rgyan spangs pa/ rab tu 'tsher ba lo bcu gnyis ma'i lang tsho can du gyur nas/ dpal ldan bla ma dam pa skyabs gsum gyi lhan cig skyes ma rdo rje rnal 'byor ma dang dbyer med par gyur te/ skyabs mchog gsum gyi sku gsung thugs kyi bde ba rgyun mi chad par bskul zhing mchod pas skyabs yul bdag sogs mkha' mnyam gyi sems can thams cad dang skyabs gnas dkon mchog rin po che rnam pa gsum phan tshun 'bral mi phod pa'i bde ba'i mchod pa las phyir nyams pa med par rjes su 'dzin par bsgom mo// de kho na nyid kyi mchod pa ni/ mchod bya mchod yul mchod pa thams cad dngos po la de ltar rang rgyud du grub na/ de lta bu'i tshad gzhal med pa'i mchod pas mchod mi nus pas/ de'i bsags 'bras kyi rang gzhan thams cad rdo rje 'chang gi go 'phang thob par yang mi nus pa zhig na de lta yang ma yin pa'i phyir/ mchod sogs kyi bya byed de dang der (46)ma grub bzhin du mchod pa'i rol pa mtha' med du 'phrul ba sgyu ma thams cad nyid kyi phyir/

sgyu ma lta bu'i rgyu las sgyu ma lta bu'i 'bras bu rgyun mi chad par 'byung ba'i rten 'brel gyi chos ngo mtshar ba la je cher brod pa dang bcas te/ mchod sogs ngoms pa med pa'i dge rtsa mchog mi shes pa la bslab par bya'o// de nas bdag 'bul ba ni/ 'di skad du/ oṃ tri ratna pū dzo pasthā ātmā naṃ nirmā ta yā mi/ zhes pas/ bdag dus da nas bzung ste ji srid sangs ma rgyas kyi bar srid zhi'i 'jigs pa las skyob pa'i skyabs gnas zhu/ de yang ji ltar zhu na/ bla ma sangs rgyas la srid zhi las skyob thabs ston pa'i ston pa po sangs rgyas/ thabs de nyid nyams su blangs pas skyob par 'gyur ba nyid kyis bskyab pa chos/ de ltar sgrub par mdzad pa'i grogs mchog dge 'dun de las gzhan du dgongs byar med pa rnams la de'i grogs ram zhu ba ni dge 'dun te/ skyabs gsum po de la/ bdag kho nar ma zad mkha' khyab sems can thams cad de'i ched du skyabs su 'gro bar mos te/ ngag tu/ bdag gzhan ma nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad bla ma sangs rgyas dkon mchog chos kyi sku la skyabs su mchi'o// bdag gzhan ma nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad bla ma sangs rgyas bde stong dbyer med dam chos dkon mchog longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku la skyabs su mchi'o// ma nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad 'gyur med thugs can dge 'dun dkon mchog sprul pa'i sku la skyabs su mchi'o// zhes rtse gcig pas skyabs 'gro drag po yun ring du byas nas de'i mthar sems bskyed cing 'dod don gsol ba gdab pa ni/ skyabs gnas mchog gyur rig 'dzin gsang sngags kyi// dkon mchog gsum gyi dngos de bdag nyid dang*// 'gro ba kun gyi thob byed dang por bdag /rdo rje 'chang dbang go 'phang bsgrub par bya// de yi spyod pa ma lus spyad par bgyi// de yi log phyogs kun las bskyab tu gsol// bdud bzhi'i bar chad kun las bsrung bar mdzod// ji ltar 'dod pa'i mngon rtogs 'char ba dang*// 'gal rkyen sgrib gnyis ma lus byang ba dang*// tshogs gnyis bsags pa stobs su 'phel ba nas// rdo rje 'chang chen go 'phang 'grub par mdzod// ces gsol ba btab nas/

dkon mchog gsum kyang rang gi gnas gsum du thim pa'i mos pas ji skad du/ bsod nams 'di yi rnam gsum srid pa la gnas sems can rnams ni bla med byang chub thob par shog /ces (48)bsngos nas thun mtshams kyi bya ba la 'jug go /'di ltar skyabs su 'gro ba'ang*/ ji skad du/ sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun la ni mi rnams thar pa'i slad du skyabs su nye bar 'gro ba ste// zhes 'byung la/ 'gro tshul yang tshe 'di'i 'du 'dzi thams cad dor nas tshad med bzhi dang sems bskyed pa sngon du 'gro ba can gyi skyabs su 'gro bar bya dgos par gsungs te/ 'grel chen las/ sems can thams cad bu gcig pa lta bur mchog tu brtse ba'i sems rjes su bcings pa/ 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i bden pa la brten nas/ bu dang chung ma la sogs pa dang rang gi lus la ltos pa med pa/ tshogs khang dang gtsug lag khang dang bla ma'i rdzas nye bar longs spyod pa las phyi rol du gyur pa/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' lam la bsten pa byams pa dang snying rje dang dga' ba dang btang snyoms te tshangs pa'i gnas bzhis rnam par gnas pa/ zhes 'byung ngo*// 'di lta'i skyabs gsum kyang rang gi rdo rje slob dpon nyid sangs rgyas de'i bstan pa chos dang*/ de'i nang rig 'gyur med kyi bka' drin thob pa dge 'dun te sems can la snying rje'i dbang du gyur pa/ rnal 'byor pha ma dang tha na dbang bdun thob pa'i dge bsnyen pha ma yan chad bzung ba yin te/ ji skad du/ slob dpon dag ni (49)sangs rgyas nyid de rab mchog sa yi gzhi la chos ni de yi bstan pa'o// dge 'dun gang zhig der gnas rab tu dga' ba'i snying dang sems can kun la rjes su brtse ba ste// de 'dir rnam bzhi rnam pa gnyis gsungs 'dir ni slar yang nyan thos pa dang bla na med pa'o// dge slong rnams dang dge slong ma dang slar yang 'di ni dge bsnyen chen po dag dang dge bsnyen ma// rnal 'byor ma dang rnal 'byor pa rnams lhan skyes bde ba la dga' dge bsnyen yang*// zhes so// de'i rten sku gzugs glegs bam rgyu'i theg pa dang*/

so skye'i dge 'dun rnams ni skyabs gnas kyi gzugs brnyan tsam las dngos ni ma yin te/ ji skad du/ 'dir ni sangs rgyas gtsug lag khang na gnas pa 'di dang yi ger bris pa'i glegs bam chos nyid dang*// dge 'dun ngur smrig 'dzin pa mchog gi khyab bdag bde ba skye ba 'bum phrag rnams kyis ster ba min// zhes 'byung la/ slob dpon de nyid kyi sku gsung thugs gsum ni mchog gsum dang*/ sku gsum ste/ rdor phreng du/ dri med sems ni sangs rgyas 'gyur// chos ni ngag tu yang dag gsungs// sku ni dge 'dun zhes gsungs te// byang chub sems dpa'i (50)tshogs kyi gnas// zhes 'byung la/ de dag la yo byad kyi mchod pas mchog gi go 'phang thob pa ni/ ji skad du/ bsod nams ye shes don gyi slad du rtag par mchog tu 'dod pa'i sbyin pa rnam pa sna tshogs kyang*// nyan thos rnams la mchod ston la sogs rnal 'byor pa la mchog gi bde byed 'dod pa'i sbyin pa yang*// sbyin pa po gang rab tu dga' ba'i snying dang dus kun tu ni chags pa'i sems kyis sbyin byed pa// de dag bsod nams ye shes rdzogs te mchog gi bde ba'i gnas su skye ba 'di la 'gro bar 'gyur// zhes 'byung ngo*// gnyis pa ni/ sems can thams cad sangs rgyas thob pa'i phyir rdo rje sems dpa'i sgom bzlas kyis bdag sogs 'gro ba thams cad kyi sdig sgrib sbyang bar bya snyam na/ rang gzhan nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad kyi spyi bo'i steng du paṃ las padma/ a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hūm̐ las rdo rje dkar po rtse lnga pa lte ba la hūm̐ gis mtshan pa/ de las 'od zer dpag tu med pa 'phros/ 'phags pa mchod/ sems can gyi sdig sgrib sbyangs tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa las/ bcom ldan 'das rdo rje sems dpa' sku mdog dkar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pas rang (51)'dra'i yum rdo rje snyems ma dkar mo gri thod 'dzin pa la 'khyud pa/

dar dang rin po che'i rgyan sna tshogs kyis brgyan pa/ yab yum de dag gi gnas gsum du oṃ āḥhūm̐ las 'od 'phros/ ye shes pa sbyangs nas dam tshig pa dang dbyer med du gyur pa la/ slar sangs rgyas thams cad kyis dbang bskur/ spyi bor rigs kyi bdag po mi bskyod pa sprul skus dbu brgyan par gyur/ slar yang yab yum gyi thugs kar zla gdan hūm̐ yig dang bcas pa'i mthar yi ge brgya pa'i sngags phreng 'od zer gyi 'phro 'du rab tu 'bar bar bsam/ de la dad 'dun drag pos bdag sogs mkha' mnyam sems can thams cad kyi tshe rabs thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i sdig sgrib nyes ltung dri ma'i tshogs thams cad byang zhing dag par mdzad du gsol zhes gsol ba btab pas/ thugs ka'i sa bon las ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i rgyun byung*/ sku'i nang gang*/ yab yum kyi sbyor mtshams nas bdag sogs mkha' mnyam sems can thams cad kyi spyi bo tshangs pa'i bu ga nas mar babs/ bdag sogs sems can thams cad kyi spyi mgrin snying lte gsang gnas nas rkang mthil gyi bar du rim pas skya me re re khengs nas lus kyi sdig sgrib thams cad nad khu der rnag (52)khrag gi rnam par bshang gci dang ba spu'i mthar phyir thon nas/ de'i shul du bla ma yab yum kyi thugs ka'i ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i ngo bo'i byang chub kyi sems dkar dmar gyis gang bas sdig sgrib thams cad dang bral lo zhes nga rgyal 'dzin bzhin par/ oṃ badzra sa twa hūm̐/

brtag gnyis snying 'grel dpang 'gyur las/ zhes pa'am/ oṃ badzra sa twa sa ma ya ma nu pā la ya/ rdo rje sems dpa' dam tshig rjes su skyongs shig / dṛ ddho me bha wa/ brtan pa'i bdag nyid kyi rang bzhin/ su to ṣyo me bha wa/ dga' ba'i bdag nyid kyi rang bzhin/ shā shwa tyo me bha wa/ dbugs 'byin pa'i bdag nyid kyi rang bzhin/ a nu rakto me bha wa/ rjes su chags pa'i bdag nyid kyi rang bzhin/ hri da bdag gi snying la byin gyis brlabs/ yaṃ me a dhi na sarba siddhimme pra yatstsha/ dngos grub thams cad bdag la rab tu stsol/ sarba karma su tsa me tsittaṃ shre yāḥku ru hūm̐/ las thams cad bdag gi snying la gnas par mdzod/ ha ha ha ha hoḥ bha ga wan/ bcom ldan 'das/ sarba ta thā ga ta badzra de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi rdo rje/ mā me bdag ma dor/ muñtsa/ badzra bha wa/ ma hā sa ma ya satwa āḥ rdo rje'i rang bzhin gyi dam tshig sems dpa' chen po/ zhes ci nus su gsol ba btab pa'i mthar/ (53)'gro kun sgrib gnyis dag par mdzad du gsol// tshogs gnyis myur du rdzogs par byin gyis rlobs// sa lam mngon rtogs bskrun par mdzad du gsol// rang gzhan don gnyis 'grub par byin gyis rlobs// zhes gsol ba btab pas/ rdo rje sems dpa'i zhal nas/ rigs kyi bu khyod kyi sdig sgrib thams cad dag cing byang bar byin gyis rlabs pa yin no zhes gsung*/ dbugs phyung ste/ rang la 'od kyi rang bzhin du thim pas/ rang nyid rdor sems kyi sku chu zla ltar snang la rang bzhin med par gyur par sgom pa la sems bzung*/ rnam rtog 'phros na dge ba bsngos la thun mtshams kyi bya ba la 'jug go /de lta'i sdig sgrib la'ang las nyon rnam smin gyi cha gsum las/ 'dir dngos su las sgrib nyid sbyong byed du bsngags shing zhar las sgrib pa gzhan sbyong bar byed la/ las sgrib la'ang rang gi sgo gsum gyi las dang*/ gzhan grogs kyi mi dge ba'i bshes gnyen sogs kyis bskul ba'i las kyi dbang du byas nas/

'grel chen las/ de rnams las lus kyi sgrib pa ni phung po'i bdud do// ngag gi sgrib pa ni nyon mongs pa'i bdud do// sems kyi sgrib pa ni 'chi bdag gi bdud do// phyi rol gyi ma rig pa'i 'jug pa ni lha'i bdud do// zhes (54)'byung ngo*// 'dod pa khams nyid 'dir bdud thams cad kyi gtso bo sdig pa'i las nyid sbyong ba la cho ga 'di nyid lhag par bsngags pa yin te/ rdo rje rtse mor/ yig brgya bstan pa'i rjes thogs su// mtshams med lnga po byed pa yang*// rdo rje sems dpa' 'dra bar 'gyur// phyag rgya thams cad 'grub 'gyur zhing*// thams cad 'grub par the tshom med// ces 'byung la/ der ma zad cho ga 'dis dngos grub thams cad kyang 'grub par byed do// mngon brjod bla ma las/ thog ma dbus dang mthar thug par// yi ge brgya pa'i gsang sngags bzla// 'khor lo dag ni brtan byas te// dpa' bo de ni mkha' 'gro ma// 'di ni kun gyi gsang sngags te// khro bo sangs rgyas de bzhin gshegs// thams cad snying gar brtan byas te// sgom pas thams cad brtan par 'gyur// gal te bdag nyid dngos grub 'dod// dngos grub thams cad gnas pa yin// zhes 'byung ngo*// de lta'i rdor sems kyang*/ de nyid bsdus pa/ dpal mchog /gdan bzhi/ gsang 'dus kyi sgrub thabs nag po pas mdzad pa dang*/ snying po mdor bsags sogs su dkar po rdor dril 'dzin par gsungs kyang*/ dus 'khor las/ rdor sems sngon po dbus zhal sngo g.yas dmar g.yon (55)dkar ba'i zhal gsum pa dang*/ phyag drug pa'i g.yas kyi dang po na rdo rje/ gnyis pa na gri gug /gsum pa na dgra sta'o// g.yon gyi dang po na dril bu/ gnyis pa na thod pa/ gsum pa na tshangs pa'i mgo bo 'dzin par yang bshad do// bzlas sngags 'di ji ltar bzla tshul ni/ thog mthar oṃ dang hūm̐ phaṭa kyis byin gyis brlabs te bzla bar bya dgos zhes/ 'grel chen las/

oṃ yig dang po'i ming thams cad la mchod par bya ste sku rdo rje'o// de bzhin du/ yan lag so so la dang por sku rdo rje dang*/ mthar thug rdo rje hūm̐ phaṭa ces pa byin nas bzlas par bya'o// de bzhin du sems can thams cad kyi lus dang ngag dang yid kyi dbye ba'o// zhes gsungs so// gsum pa ni/ mdun gyi smin mtshams kyi nam mkha'i thad du sangs rgyas kyi zhing khams gzhal yas khang rgyan rta babs thog nor bu rin po che'i tog dang bcas pa 'od zer 'bar zhing 'khrug pa'i dbus su seng ge'i khri pad nyi'i gdan la/ rtsa ba'i bla ma rigs bsdus rdo rje 'chang chen po yab yum gsal ba'i 'khor du yi dam rgyud sde bzhi'i lha tshogs/ de mthar phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas byang sems nyan rang dgra bcom/ de mthar bka' sdod dam can rgya (56)mtsho'i tshogs kyis bskor ba/ brgyud pa'i bla ma thams cad steng gi bar snang la sprin phung gtibs pa ltar bzhugs pa'i thugs ka nas/ slar yang 'od 'phros chos dbyings rang bzhin rnam par dag pa'i gnas na bzhugs pa'i bla ma yi dam sangs rgyas byang sems 'phags pa nyan rang dgra bcom pa rnams spyan drangs te gnyis su med par bstim nas/ skyabs gnas thams cad gcig tu bsdus pa'i ngo bo rigs thams cad kyi bdag po bcom ldan 'das rdo rje 'chang chen po la mos gus rtse gcig tu byas nas/ rgyu rin po che las byas pa'am/ med na sa gzhi bstar zhing byi dor byas pa khru gang las mi chung ba la ba byung lnga dang dri bzang bdud rtsi lnga dang bsres pa'i chus chag chag gdab cing oṃ badzra bhū mi hūm̐/ zhes pas sa gzhi dang*/ oṃ badzra re khe āḥhūm̐ gis mtha'i ri mo byin gyis brlabs la/ oṃ āḥlas byung ba'i ri rab/ ya las shar du lus 'phags po/ ra las lho ru dzambu gling*/ la las nub tu ba lang spyod/ wa las byang sgra mi snyan/ mdun du haṃ las zla ba/ rgyab tu ha las nyi ma/

phyi lcags ri mu khyud kyis bskor ba'i nang thams cad du rin po che la sogs pa lha mi'i dpal 'byor (57)yongs su rdzogs pas gang ba dang bdag dang gzhan dus gsum du bsags pa'i longs spyod 'khor 'das dus gsum du bsags yod kyi dge rtsa mtha' dag bla ma rin po che gtso bor gyur pa'i skyabs yul rnams la 'bul ba'i mos pas/ 'gro ba kun gyi dge tshogs ci mchis dang*// snod bcud zhing mchog kun bzang mchod pa'i sprin// gus pas bla ma dkon mchog rnams la 'bul// thugs rjes bzhes nas byin gyis brlab tu gsol// gu ru i dam maṇḍal kaṃ nidyā ta ya mi/ dkyil 'khor 'di bla ma la dbul bar bgyi'o// zhes maṇḍal 'degs su yod na smin mtshams su bteg /med na bteg par bsams la/ khyod ni ma dang khyod ni pha ste khyod ni 'gro ba'i bla ma khyod ni gnyen dang grogs bzang yang*// khyod ni mgon po khyod ni byed po phan dang sdig 'phrog khyod ni go 'phang phun sum tshogs pa yang*// khyod ni 'ba' zhig gnas dang khyod ni yon tan mchog gi gnas te skyon rnams bcom pa khyod nyid do// khyod ni dman pa rnams kyi mgon dang yid bzhin nor bu rgyal ba'i dbang po khyod la bdag skyabs mchi// zhes pas phyag 'tshal lo nas/ oṃ gandhaṃ pra tītstsha swā hā dri/ badzra puṣpaṃ gyis (58)me tog /badzra dhū paṃ gyis bdug pa/ badzra di paṃ gyis sgron me/ badzra ākṣa tam gyis ma nyams pa/ badzra nai widyaṃ zhal zas/ badzra lā syas sgeg mo/ badzra hā syas bzhad ma/ badzra shā dyaṃ gis sil snyan ma/ badzra nṛ tyaṃ gis gar ma/ badzra gi tyaṃ gis glu ma/ badzra kā maṃ gyis 'dod mas mchod nas// thog med dus nas lus ngag yid kyis sdig pa rnam pa mang po bsags pa dag ni bshags par bgyis// rdzogs sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' rnams dang 'phags pa'i tshogs kyis rnam mang dge ba gang byas pa// de rnams mtha' dag la ni sdig pa rnam bral byang chub spyod la rjes su gnas pas rjes yi rang*// sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun srid pa'i 'jigs 'phrog la yang byang chub bar du bdag ni skyabs su mchi// rdzogs sangs rgyas su bdag gyur cig ces 'dir ni smon lam sems can don gyi slad du bdag bgyid do// ces pas mchod de/

badzra muḥmaṇḍal gyis tshom bu bsdus te/ dge 'dis bdag dang 'gro kun thams cad pa// sku gsum rab 'byams zhing gi longs spyod la// mnga' dbang bsgyur nas ma dag snod bcud rnams// dag pa rab 'byams nyid du 'grub phyir bsngo// zhes sogs bsngo bas (59)rgyas btab po// de ltar maṇḍal dbul ba ni da lta blos sbyang ba tsam yin gyi rang gi dngos su dbang byar yod na dag ma dag gi zhing 'tshal to cog gi bde 'byor sems can thams cad 'tshang rgya ba'i ched du skyabs gnas rnams la 'bul dgos kyi/ de ltar 'bul ba'i bsod tshogs gzhal med ma byas par rang gzhan sems can thams cad 'tshang rgya bar nus pa'i tshogs rdzogs par mi 'gyur la/ des na da lta dngos su dbang byar med kyang yid kyis blangs nas phul na dngos su dbang byar yod pa phul ba dang bsod nams mnyam par thob cing*/ de 'bras la 'khor 'das kyi zhing rab 'byams la dbang ba'i 'khor lo bsgyur rgyal dang tshangs pa sogs 'jig rten skyong ba rnams su skyes nas sangs rgyas grangs med pa la bskal pa grangs med par dngos su bsnyen nus pa'i dge rtsa'i stobs dang ldan par skye bar yang 'gyur ro// lhag par de'i ched du dbang rgyud nod cing lam sgom pa'i dus su ni rang gi 'byor pa yod dgu cog 'bul bas bsod tshogs gzhan las cher rdzogs shing ma phul na gzhan las sdig lci bar gsungs te/ ye shes snying po rnal 'byor ma'i rgyud du/ slob dpon la dbang bskur ba'i dus sam/ rgyud thos pa'i dus su shin tu (60)gces pa'i chung ma dang*/ bu mo dang*/ gzhan yang gser dang*/ mu tig dang nor bu dang glang po che dang rta dang zhing dang bran dang bran mo dang na bza' du ma la sogs pa ci tsam nus pa dbul bar bya'o// nor la sogs pa yod nas gang zhig mi 'bul na de ni bskal pa stong gi bar du dmyal bar skye bar 'gyur ro// longs spyod med par gyur pas kyang rang gi lus po dbul bar bya ste bran du'o// des na tshe 'di nyid la sangs rgyas nyid dam// yang na rdo rje 'dzin pa nyid thob par 'gyur// zhes dang*/

rim lngar/ bla med byed pa slob dpon gyis// rdo rje sems dpa' mchod byas pas// de yi bsod nams ma byas shing*// dka' thub ma bstan gang zhig yod// de nyid mi zad 'dod pa yis// shin tu dga' ba gang dang gang*// shin tu khyad par can de nyid// de dang de ni bla mar dbul// zhes 'byung ngo*// 'o na bla ma mchod pa tsam gyis tshe 'dir 'tshang rgya ba ci zhe na/ mchod tsam kho nas ma yin gyi rkyen de nyid kyi tshogs gnyis rdzogs sgrib gnyis 'byongs pa la mthu thob phul che bas thabs 'dis tshe gcig la sangs rgyas par byed pa'i nye rgyur mchog tu bsngags pa yin te/ ye shes snying por/ lha mo sbyin pa la sogs pa tsam gyis (61)sangs rgyas sam rdo rje 'dzin par mi 'gyur te/ 'on kyang bla ma la mchod pas bsod nams chen po'i tshogs skye'o// bsod nams chen po'i tshogs bsags pa las sdig pa'i phung po zad de/ bla ma'i mchog sangs rgyas thams cad kyi rang bzhin rang gi lha'i sku yang dag pa dang 'phrad pa 'thob bo// phrad pas yang dag pa'i man ngag gnang bar 'gyur ro// man ngag thob pa las brtson 'grus chen po dang ldan pa yin na/ des tshe 'di nyid la sangs rgyas sam rdo rje 'dzin pa thob par 'gyur ro// zhes so// 'o na bla ma la bsnyen bkur gyi mchog gam thog ma ni phyag dang maṇḍal yin te/ maṇḍal ni bla ma bzhugs pa'i gnas dang nye 'khor dang bcas par dri bzang gi skyang nul dang me tog gi sil ma bkram pa sogs kyis bzhugs pa'i gnas mdzes shing yid du 'ong ba dri ngad ldang bar byas pas dgyes pa rab tu bskyed pa'i tshul gyis mchod par bya ste/ de lta'i dkyil 'khor de nyid du 'khor 'das thams cad kyi zhing gi yon tan bsdus shing yang dag par sbyangs nas skyabs gnas thams cad la 'bul bar byed pa ni mdo sngags gnyis ka nas kyi sangs rgyas kyi zhing yongs su sbyangs pa'i man ngag dam par bsngags pa yin te/

ji skad du/ sdig can gang yin gang zhig dpal ldan (62)bla ma'i zhabs pad bzang po dag la dus gsum phyag mi byed// mi shes gang yin gang zhig rnam mang me tog rnams kyis dus gsum du ni maṇḍal mi byed pa// zhes 'byung ba nyid kyi phyir/ de las bzlog ste bla ma'i gan du phyag dang dkyil 'khor pa bya ba'i tshul la/ don dam bsnyen par/ thun mtshams gsum du rnam par dag pa yis// kha dang lag pa rkang pa dag ni bkrus byas te// me tog yang dag blangs nas bla ma'i spyan sngar ni// rgyal ba rnams kyi dkyil 'khor shin tu zlum por bya// bla ma'i zhabs kyi chu skyes me tog gis mchod cing*// shin tu gus pas spyi bo lag pas phyag 'tshal lo// zhes 'byung ba ltar yin la/ maṇḍal gyi tshom bu 'god tshul la'ang*/ rgyud dang slob dpon 'grel pa mkhan po rnams kyis du mar gsungs na'ang*/ phyi nang gzhan gsum gyi dag pas mchod tshogs thams cad 'byung ba gnas pa rten gyi brten pa mtha' dag bsdus pa nyid kyi rten 'brel gyi gnad kyi maṇḍal gyi mchod pa 'dir ni phyi nang gsang ba de kho na'i mchod pa ma lus pa 'du ba nyid kyi phyir/ mchod pa 'di la ni ma 'dus pa'i mchod pa gcig kyang yod pa ma yin te/ (63)ri rab gcig pu'i khongs su 'khor 'das kyi srid gsum gyi 'byor pa thams cad rdzogs pa'i phyir te/ rdo rje snying 'grel las/ ya ra la wa yi ge gang*// rlung me sa dang chu las skyes// shar dang lho dang nub dang ni// byang rnams su ni nges sbyar bya// ring po me dang bden bral dang*// rlung dang dbang ldan rim pa las// steng dang 'og tu haṃ haḥsbyin// dbus su aṃ aḥrab mchod bya// sangs rgyas kun dang bla ma dang*// dam pa'i chos ni klog pa yi// don du mdun du maṇḍal bya// gzhan pa rgyal ba mnga' bdag nyid// rlung gi dkyil 'khor chos kyi ni// zlum po shar gyi lus 'phags po// me yi dkyil 'khor ngo bo yis// dzambu'i gling ste zur gsum pa// gru bzhi nub kyi ba lang spyod// sa yi dkyil 'khor mtshan nyid can// chu yi dkyil 'khor chos can gyis// zla phyed byang gi sgra mi snyan// stong pa'i ngo bo'i zla ba yis// dkyil 'khor mtshan nyid tshang sgo nga// 'og tu ye shes ngo bo yi// dus me nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor ro// dbus su thig le rnam bcad ni// steng 'og lha yi ngo bor gyur// zhes 'byung ba ltar ro// bzhi pa ni/

bdag nyid yi (64)dam gyi lhar gsal ba'i spyi bor pad nyi'i steng du dpal ldan bla ma dam pa sum ldan rdo rje 'dzin pa chen po rigs kyi bdag po drug pa rdo rje 'chang yab yum yongs su gsal ba'i gnas gsum la 'bru gsum las 'od 'phros/ phyogs bcu dus gsum gyi rgyal ba sras dang slob mar bcas pa mtha' dag rtsa brgyud kyi bla ma/ tshe rabs gzhan du zhal mjal gsung thos tsam gyi 'brel pa yod do cog gi rnam par gyur pa ma lus pa spyan drangs te bstim nas/ de yang steng nas byon pa rnams ni char bab pa lta bu dang*/ 'og nas byon pa rnams ni sa rlangs chen po thim pa lta bu dang*/ thad nas byon pa rnams ni bu yug 'tshubs pa ltar thim par bsgoms te/ mos gus kyi gdung ba drag pos/ dpal ldan rtsa ba'i bla ma rin po che// bdag gi spyi gtsug nyi zla'i gdan steng du// bka' drin chen po'i sgo nas rjes bzung ste// sku gsung thugs kyi dngos grub stsal du gsol// zhes gsol ba btab cing*/ lus kyi ba spu ldang zhing mchi ma char brubs pa tsam du gsol ba btab nas bla ma'i thugs ka nas 'od zer dpag med 'phros nas/ phyi snod kyi 'jig rten thams cad la phog pas gzhal yas khang (65)du gyur/ nang bcud kyi sems can thams cad la phog pas lha dang lha mor gyur nas/ dpal ldan bla ma dam pa phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba sras dang slob mar bcas pa la mchod pa brnyes te/ de dag byang chub kyi sems bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun du gyur nas spyi bo'i dpal ldan bla ma nyid kyi sgo gsum mchod par mdzad de/ de nyid kyi rdo rje gsum gyi gnas nas brgyud de bdag gi sgo gsum la thim pas/ smin grol la gegs byed kyi sdig sgrib thams cad dag nas dbang gi rtogs pa skye rung dang*/ sa lam gyi yon tan 'char nus kyi lus sems me shel dri ma med pa lta bur dag par bsgoms nas dbang bzhi len pa ni/

bla ma rin po che'i dpral ba'i oṃ dkar po las/ bcom ldan 'das rnam par snang mdzad sku rdo rje'i lha tshogs bsam gyis mi khyab pa spros/ sku rdo rjes gdul bar bya ba'i sems can thams cad sku rdo rje'i go 'phang la bkod/ tshur 'dus rang gi dpral bar 'od dkar po'i rnam par thim pas ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun gyis lus sems thams cad blugs gang bkrus/ bum pa'i dbang thob/ sad pa dang lus kyi dri ma dag /yul snang stong brjod bral du rtogs/ 'bras bus sku rdo rje'i go 'phang mngon (66)sum du byas te/ rang nyid bcom ldan 'das rnam par snang mdzad kyi skur gyur/ yang bla ma rin po che'i mgrin pa'i āḥdamar po las bcom ldan 'das 'od dpag med gsung rdo rje'i lha tshogs su gyur pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa spros/ gsung rdo rjes gdul bar bya ba'i sems can thams cad gsung rdo rje'i go 'phang la bkod/ tshur 'dus rang gi mgrin par 'od dmar po'i rnam par thim pas byang chub kyi sems kyi bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun gyi rtsa rlung thams cad blug gang bkrus/ gsang ba'i dbang thob/ rmi lam dang ngag gi dri ma dag sems gsal stong brjod bral du rtogs/ 'bras bu gsung rdo rje'i go 'phang mngon sum du byas te/ rang nyid bcom ldan 'das 'od dpag med kyi skur gyur/ yang bla ma rin po che'i thugs ka'i sgra gcan gyi dkyil 'khor du hūm̐ sngon po la bcom ldan 'das mi bskyod pa thugs rdo rje'i lha tshogs su gyur pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa spros/ thugs rdo rjes gdul bar bya ba'i sems can thams cad thugs rdo rje'i go 'phang la bkod/ tshur 'dus rang gi snying gar 'od sngon po'i rnam par thim pas/ byang chub kyi sems kyi bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun gyis thig sems thams cad blug gang bkrus/ shes rab ye shes kyi dbang thob/ gnyid stug dang sems kyi dri ma dag /(67)rang rig bde stong brjod bral du rtogs/

'bras bu thugs rdo rje'i go 'phang mngon du byas te/ rang nyid bcom ldan 'das mi bskyod pa'i skur gyur/ de nas bla ma rin po che'i spyi gtsug nas rkang mthil gyi bar gyi 'od zer sna tshogs pa bcom ldan 'das rdo rje 'chang gi lha tshogs kyi rnam par spros/ ngo bo nyid sku gdul ba'i sems can thams cad ngo bo nyid sku'i go 'phang la bkod tshur 'dus lus thams cad la 'od zer sna tshogs kyi rnam par thim pas/ byang chub kyi sems bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun gyi ye shes kyi cha thams cad blug gang bkrus/ bzhi pa'i dbang thob/ bzhi pa dang sgo gsum gyi bag chags dri ma dang bcas pa dag sgo gsum gyis bsdus pa'i 'khor 'das bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i ngo bor rtogs/ 'bras bu ngo bo nyid sku'i go 'phang mngon sum du byas te/ rang nyid rigs drug pa bcom ldan 'das rdo rje 'chang chen po'i skur gyur/ de nas rang dang bla ma tha dad du rtog pa spang ba'i phyir/ bdag gi lus ngag yid gsum dang*/ dpal ldan bla ma dam pa'i rdo rje gsum dbyer med par gyur snyam du nga rgyal bzung ba'i snying gar pad nyi zla ba'i gdan du rang gi rtsa ba'i bla ma nyid bcom ldan 'das shrī he ru ka yab yum du gsal ba'i thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros (68)nas rgyal ba sras dang slob mar bcas pa thams cad kyi thugs brgyud mkhyen brtse nus pa thams cad spyan drangs te dbyer med du gyur par bsgoms te/ rnam par dag pa'i ye shes kyi rlung bzung ba'i rang sgra dang*/ snying gar shrī he ru ka yab yum gyi thugs ka'i hūm̐ yig gi mthar oṃ āḥhūm̐ gi sgra rab tu grags pa'i sgra 'od zer gsum gyi yid zlos rtse gcig tu bya zhing de'i sgra 'od zer gsum gyi mkha' mnyam sems can thams cad la phog pas 'gro ba thams cad kyang bdag nyid lhag pa'i lha dang dpal ldan bla ma'i ngo bor dag pa ci lta ba de lta'i dag par bsgoms nas/

bdag nyid kyi 'dod bya'i mthar thug mchog gi dngos grub dang*/ thun mong gi dngos grub 'dod bya gang yin pa thams cad la sgra 'od zer gsum lcags kyu'i rnam pas bkug ste rang gis longs spyod par bsam zhing*/ de lta'i dge ba byang chub tu bsngo ba ni/ bdag gi bla ma'i lam gyi dge ba 'dis// 'gro kun rdo rje 'chang chen 'grub gyur nas// dpal ldan bla ma'i bzhed pa ci mchis pa// bdag gis skad cig nyid 'dir 'grub phyir bsngo// zhes bsngo ba dang smon lam ci rigs par 'debs so// de ltar bskyed rdzogs kyi dkyil 'khor rgyas pa bsgrubs nas dbang mi len par bla ma nyid la brten nas (69)smin grol gyi dbang len pa la nan tan byed pa ci yin zhe na/ bla ma nyid dkyil 'khor par bsgrubs nas smin grol gyi dbang blangs pa las mchog thun mong gi dngos grub la mnga' dbang bsgyur ba 'grub mod kyang*/ dkyil 'khor pa nyid bla mar bsgrubs nas smin grol gyi dbang blangs pa las mchog thun mong gi dngos grub bde myur du 'grub pa ni rnal 'byor 'di nyid kyi nye lam mchog tu gyur pa nyid du gnas pa'i phyir/ mos gus bla ma'i rnal 'byor 'di nyid la mchog tu bsngags pa yin te/ dpal mgon klu sgrub kyis/ ri dbang rtse las 'ga' zhig ltung gyur na// ltung bar mi 'gyur snyam yang ltung bar 'gyur// bla ma'i drin gyis phan pa'i lung thob na// grol bar mi 'gyur snyam yang grol bar 'gyur// zhes dang*/ ye shes thig ler/ bla ma'i zhal snga'i bka' drin gyis// mchog gi gnas ni rnyed par 'gyur// tshe 'di yi ni phyag rgya che// dngos grub rnyed par the tshom med// sa bcu yi ni dbang phyug bdag /de yi bka' drin gyis ni slad// zhes dang*/ phyag thig tu/ ji ltar me yis (70)shing tshig pa// skad cig gis ni thal bar byed// gal te de bzhin dpal bla ma// mnyes na skad cig gis sdig 'tshig

/ces dang*/ rim lngar/ slob dpon gyis ni sdig pa 'phrog /slob dpon gyis ni 'jigs pa sel// slob dpon gyis ni sdug bsngal gyi// rgya mtsho'i 'jigs las pha rol sgrol// zhes 'byung la/ de lta'i bla ma ni rdo rje sems dpa' nyid yin la yin bzhin du blta bar bya dgos te/ de nyid las/ gang zhig dbang bskur smin byed pa// de ni rdor sems lta bur blta// bla ma sprul rgyal lta bur blta// bla ma ston pa bas lhag blta// yid bzhin rin chen mnyam par blta// zhes 'byung la/ de'i phyir de la phan gnod byas pas rgyal po la phan gnod byed par 'gyur te// gang gi mi yi 'jig rten dag na dpal ldan bla ma rdo rje 'dzin pa sdig bral de bdag ste// de la gnod pa byas pas srog chags rnams ni nges par dmyal bar 'gyur te 'di la ngo mtshar med// de mnyes pa yis bdag ni mgu ste de la khro ba'i me yis khros pa zhes pa chen po'o// zhes 'byung la/ de'i thugs sun phyung bas dmyal (71)bar 'gro la/ gus pas 'gyur med bde ba thob ste/ ji skad du/ myur du mnar med 'gro ba gang yin gang zhig bde mnyam ster byed bla ma skyo ba bskyed pa po// shes rab ye shes thob pa gang yin ma nyams gang zhig mchog gi bla ma'i zhal ni mi spong ba// zhes 'byung la/ de nyid kyi phyir bla ma dam pa mnyes par bya dgos te/ rim lngar/ mchod pa thams cad rim spangs nas// bla ma mchod pa yang dag brtsam// de mnyes pas ni kun mkhyen gyi// ye shes mchog ni thob par 'gyur// zhes 'byung la/ de lta'i slob dpon te bla ma'ang bskyed rim gyi dngos grub rtsal ba ni rgyu'i bla ma dang*/ rdzogs rim gyi dngos grub rtsal ba ni rkyen gyi bla ma ste/ de'i dang po las ni phyi ma'i bla ma nyid mchog tu bzung bar bya dgos te/ dper na dpal phag mo grub pa nyid kyi bla ma sa skya pa chen po yin pa la phyis rje sgam po pa nyid rtsa ba'i bla mar 'dzin par mdzad pa lta bu'i phyir te/

rdo rje snying rgyan du/ dam sdom gyi ni snod gtsang ma// slob dpon mtshan nyid yongs rdzogs par// (72)byed cing dang po'i las 'jug pa// byed pa rgyu yi slob dpon ni// ri bong 'dzin pa bskul byed cing*// de yi sgrub po bzhin dag cing*// ye shes sgyu ma'i snod rung byed// rkyen gyi slob dpon chen po'o// zhes 'byung ngo*// rgyu mtshan de nyid kyi phyir phyi bum dbang bskyed rim dang 'brel ba'i dbang ni de'i mngon rtogs dang ldan pa'i rgyu'i bla mas kyang dbang bskur bar btub la/ nang dbang gong ma rdzogs rim dang 'brel ba'i dbang ni rgyu'i bla mas bskur mi btub par rkyen gyi slob dpon chen po rdzogs rim gyi mngon rtogs thob pa nyid kyis bya dgos pa yin te/ dper na rje mi las grub pa'i dbang phyug zhi ba 'od/ ba ri lo tsa ba la dbang zhur bcug nas/ phyis rje btsun nyid kyi gdams pa gnang nas lus ma spangs par mkha' spyod du bzhud nas phyi rabs dang ba bskyed pa'i phyir brag khung gi spyi bo brdol ba'i rdzu 'phrul da lta'ang bstan par mdzad la/ tshul 'di 'bri gdan gyi gdan sa chen po rnams su chos sgo bas dbang sbyin/ rje rin po ches khrid 'debs pa la/ sa paṇa pas/ rdo rje phag mo'i byin rlabs kyang*// bla ma'i sku las thob pa'i phyir// (73)chos sgo ba las blang ci dgos// zhes sogs kyi zhor la/ dbang ma bskur la bla ma med// bya ba sogs kyi bum pa sogs kyi dbang ma bskur na rdzogs rim gyi khrid btab pa bla mar mi 'gyur ba dang rgyu'i bla ma gzhan gyi dbang bskur nas rkyen gyi bla mas grol bar mdzad pa'i bla ma 'di bla mar mi 'gyur ba 'gog pa ni rdo rje 'chang chen po nyid la dngos su dgag par snang ba'i phyir dang*/ chos sgo ba la phag mo'i dbang byin rlabs len pa na chos sgo ba nyid bla ma rdo rje slob dpon dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo nyid yin pas de'i sgo gsum las dbang len par byed pa'i phyir/

chos sgo ba la dbang byin brlabs blangs pas bla ma'i lus la dbang byin rlabs blang bar song ba'i gnad khyed kyis ma dgongs par snang bzhin/ chos sgo ba la blang ci dgos zhes bsal ba ye med kyi thal 'gyur 'phen pa ngo tsha ba'i gnas su mi 'gyur ram/ yang sa paṇa pas/ bdag kyang rdo rje phag mo yi// byin rlabs tsam re byas pa la// dkar po gcig thub bstan nas kyang*// myong ba cung zad skyes pa la// mthong lam du ni ngo sprad nas// rtsol sgrub med pa'i don bstan nas// tshogs pa'ang 'di bas mang ba 'du// longs spyod 'bul ba'ang mang bar 'gyur// zhes pa la bzhad gad du bya na/ gdul bya longs spyod bsdu ba'i phyir// bdag kyang bdag med lha mo (74)yi// byin rlabs tsam re byas pa la// bde stong dbyer med bstan nas kyang*// myong ba cung zad skyes pa na// mthong lam du ni ngo sprad nas// rtsol sgrub med pa'i don bstan kyang*// 'bri gung pa yi bsod nams tsam// 'byung ba'i gnas skabs yod min la// de la nga yi ci byar yod// ces smras pa na cir 'gyur te/ bla ma sa chen gyis rje phag gru la/ kye rdor yab yum gyi dbang byin rlabs tsam byas nas lus sems la bde stong gi nyams cung zad skyes pa'i bka' drin bsab phyogs kyis sa skya pa la sku bsod ma 'ur bar phyis rje sgam po pa'i drung du mthong lam de zong mar song nas mthong lam skyes pa'i bka' drin bsab phyir rje phag gru'i sgo gsum longs spyod dge rtsa dang bcas pa phul bas de'i rten 'brel gyi mthus/ rje 'gro mgon yab sras kyi 'dus pa rje btsun byams pa'i 'dus pa dang mnyam pa byung ba'i phrin las la gus pa chen pos phyag 'tshal zhing skyabs su mchi'o// spyir dpal ldan sa skya pa'i gsang sngags kyi myong ba bde bde stong stong po phal che ba ni lam du 'gro ba dka' zhes bka' gdams las/ de yang rtsa rlung thig le zer nas lus la gnad du bsnun (75)pa skad byas pas lus sems bde snyam pa dang gsal snyam pa dang mi rtog pa snyam byed pa mang du 'byung ste/

thams cad rtog pa kha tshom rer song ba la rang byung gi ye shes su rlom pa mang nas de 'dra'i rlung tsam gyi bde drod stong pa'i sgom ni phyi ba sgom chen la'ang yod zer ba bris gda' bas/ sa skya pas/ dwags po pa la rtog pa kha chom thar lam du 'dod pa dgag ces pa'ang bka' gdams sogs las ni sa skya pa'i rang byung gi ye shes su 'dod pa kun kyang rtog pa kha tshom thar lam gyi mi mthun phyogs su bshad gda' bas rnam dpyod can rnams kyi zab mo'i chos la blo ldog par mi bya'o// des na rdzogs rim gyi sngon 'gror rnal 'byor rnam pa bzhi po sbyar ba 'di la shar tsong kha pa chen pos/ skyabs sems ni bstan pa gang dang gang la 'jug pa'i sngon 'gro yin la/ rdor sems sgom bzlas kyang dam tshig gi dri ma 'dag thabs yin la/ maṇḍal yang bskyed rdzogs gnyis kar gyi lha'i mchod chog la bshad cing*/ bla ma'i rnal 'byor yang dam tshig gso ba tsam yin pas mtha' gcig tu rdzogs rim gyi sngon 'gro med ka med kyi yan lag min kyang bla ma gong ma dag (76)gis mdzad par snang ngo zhes/ rang bskyed rdzogs kyi man ngag gang las thos pa'i bla ma'i gdams ngag gis mdzad par snang ngo zhes rang bskyed rdzogs kyi man ngag gang las thos pa'i bla ma'i gdams ngag la dpyad pa skad kyi smad par byed pa ni rtsa ltung dang po'i nyes pas gos par 'gyur gyi dogs pas thar 'dod dag bag yod par gyis shig /'dir smras pa/ lam gyi mthar thug 'gyur med rnal 'byor che// phyag rgya'i las mchog nyer bder sgrub byed pa'i// man ngag gsang ba chen po'i 'dus pa yang*// rje btsun bla ma'i mthu las ma gtogs par// gzhan dring med pa'i bka' drin zab mo yis// rgya chen rgyud don ma lus 'chad bzhin no// zhes brjod do// gnyis pa dngos gzhi la/ sku phyag rgya chen po lhan cig skyes sbyor sprul sku'i khrid/ gsung phyag rgya chen po lhan cig skyes sbyor longs spyod rdzogs sku'i khrid/
